"arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicleInfo}/assetGuid", "value": "a922ecf1-f7ce-45f9-b0f8-86a23ec26c2c" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] } A built-in vehicle queue is a resource asset packed into a mod. It lists the vehicles a match may offer, is read-only in game, and feeds the battle-configuration vehicle picker. Not to be confused with PresetVehicleQueueConfig, a saved per-player config, not a packed asset. 1. Create the asset Assets > Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Base - 载具配置 > Vehicle Queue - 载具队列 Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.BuiltInVehicleQueueData)", "${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. Set Match identity and name Guid — tutorial-queue-001; a plain string, not a Unity asset GUID Vehicle Queue Type — select Match Queue Name — expand it, set Default Name to Tutorial Queue An empty Guid is generated automatically. Keep each published queue's identifier unique and stable; tutorial-queue-001 is only the pictured example. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/guid", "value": "tutorial-queue-001" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/vehicleQueueType", "value": "Match" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/queueName/defaultName", "value": "Tutorial Queue" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/vehicleQueueType" }, "expect": { "contains": "Match" } } ] 3. Add one vehicle entry In Vehicle Guids click + to add one entry, then fill its two strings: Comment = an author note, Vehicle Guid = the vehicle load identifier. The identifier is what VehicleInfo exposes: assetGuid, or the lower-cased vehicleName when assetGuid is empty. Copy it from your own driveable VehicleInfo; do not use the Unity .meta GUID or VehicleTextData.editorAssetGuid. Select that VehicleInfo asset and click Copy Asset GUID to copy the correct identifier, then paste it into Vehicle Guid. The example Comment: T-34-85 No.215 with Vehicle Guid: a922ecf1-f7ce-45f9-b0f8-86a23ec26c2c is official AAA2 content, illustrative only, and not automatically supplied to your project. The list is a set of eligible vehicles, not quantities: the item count is the entry count, and there is no spawn quantity field. How many vehicles actually appear is decided by mode settings. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions To reproduce GUID copying, setup recreates only the official T-34's name/load-ID metadata. This fixture has no model, is excluded from the pack and cannot be driven. For release, select a real driveable VehicleInfo and include its content or dependencies. Whole-list JSON assignment adds and fills entries; there is no quantity field. [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicleInfo}/GetLoadGUID", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "a922ecf1-f7ce-45f9-b0f8-86a23ec26c2c" }, "capture": { "vehicleGuid": { "regex": "\\(String\\) (.+)" } } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/vehicleGuids", "value": "[{\"comment\":\"T-34-85 No.215\",\"vehicleGuid\":\"${vehicleGuid}\"}]" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/vehicleGuids/0/vehicleGuid" }, "expect": { "contains": "${vehicleGuid}" } } ] 4. Pack with the vehicles The asset's Guid is its bundle name with variant vehiclequeue: <Guid>.vehiclequeue Add the asset to the mod build pipeline's Linked Objects (linkedObjects) Entries are strings, so they do not pull in the vehicles: put each referenced vehicle's content in this pack or an installed dependency Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions This builds the queue-definition teaching package and excludes the recreated VehicleInfo metadata. A successful build does not supply the T-34 model. Real use requires vehicle content or a mod dependency. [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${pipeline}/linkedObjects/Add", "args": [ "@asset:${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.EditorUtility/SetDirty", "args": [ "@asset:${pipeline}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/SaveAssets", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "modpack_plan", "arguments": { "pipeline": "${pipeline}" }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true, "built": false }, "contains": "\"vehiclequeue\"" }, "phase": "build" }, { "tool": "modpack_build", "arguments": { "pipeline": "${pipeline}" }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true, "archiveExists": true, "published": false, "installed": false } }, "capture": { "archivePath": { "path": "archivePath" } }, "phase": "build" }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:Frontend.Editor.ModPackageWorkshopMeta/WriteSidecar", "args": [ "${archivePath}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": ".modpack.json" }, "capture": { "sidecarPath": { "regex": "\\(String\\) (.+)" } }, "phase": "build" }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/ReadAllText", "args": [ "${sidecarPath}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "${packageGuid}" }, "phase": "build" } ] 5. Select in the battle-config picker Built-in queues appear in the current picker next to the player's own queues and are read-only in game; to change a shipped queue, edit the asset and rebuild. Lookup covers room presets, war-zone configs and built-in Match queues, so keep Match here. The asset defaults to Lobby; that list is not used by the current battle-configuration picker. A queue that shows no entries usually means the string matches no registered VehicleInfo, the vehicle is not driveable, it cannot spawn on the loaded map, or the vehicle content is missing from the pack and its dependencies. Check the identifier, dependency content and vehicle eligibility when this happens. Menu path, field names and behavior come from source and Inspector checks; the pictures are real editor captures. The shared recipe verifies the queue-definition package's Windows build, ZIP manifests and sidecar. It does not include the T-34 model and has not been installed or run in game. manual/en/mod/reactive-armor.html.title: Configure reactive armor | Panzer War Document
manual/en/mod/reactive-armor.html.summary: Configure reactive armor 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run reactive-armor --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "plate": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ReactivePlate.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } Configure reactive armor on a HitBox in the vehicle's damage model. Reactive armor tracks spent areas near valid impact points. 1. Select the HitBox Open the damage model prefab and select the part that will use reactive armor. Confirm that it has a HitBox component. The teaching recipe creates a separate armor sample. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${plate}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.HitBox" } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Set the reactive armor fields Set Armor Type to 反应 - Reactive. In the reactive armor group, set Reactive Armor Size to 0.5 and Reactive Armor Max Protect Penetration to 200. These are the code defaults used for the example. The size is the distance from a recorded trigger point. A subsequent hit within that distance receives an armor value of 0 at that position. Unspent positions use the configured reactive armor value, with penetration resolved by the game's damage calculation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${plate}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.HitBox", "values": { "hitBoxType": 3, "reactiveArmorSize": 0.5, "reactiveMaxProtectPenetration": 200 } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Save and verify Save the prefab and read back the armor type and both values. The recipe verifies the saved editor settings. Check triggering, repeated hits, and repairs in game. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "sdkCheckout": "../../../Panzer-War-Mod-SDK" }, "calls": [] } Current SDK layout The SDK contains the project in UnityProject and the shared resources package beside it in Packages/Sdk/com.shanghaiwindy.middlesharedresources. Extract the complete SDK as described in project setup and keep those two folders next to each other. The package already contains these directories; keep the exact case and spelling: SharedVFX FMod SharedInternalDamage/Preset Dependency and package inspection Confirm that UnityProject/Packages/manifest.json references the package ID com.shanghaiwindy.middlesharedresources. Confirm that the actual package directory Packages/Sdk/com.shanghaiwindy.middlesharedresources exists. Open Window → Package Manager in Unity and find Panzer War Middle Shared Resources. Early tool versions stored these resources under Assets/Res. The current SDK uses the shared package declared in its manifest.

}, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/crewName/defaultName", "value": "${title}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. Configure cooldown Set initialCdType = Ready and coolDownTime = 20. CustomRatio reveals customInitialCdRatio, the initially completed fraction. The skill cannot be released again while its shield is active, and cooldown advances only without an active shield. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/upgradableSkillContents/0/skills/0/crewSkillRef/displayValue/crewSkill/initialCdType", "value": "Ready" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/upgradableSkillContents/0/skills/0/crewSkillRef/displayValue/crewSkill/coolDownTime", "value": "20" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/upgradableSkillContents/0/skills/0/crewSkillRef/SetValue", "args": [ "@asset:${asset}/upgradableSkillContents/0/skills/0/crewSkillRef/displayValue" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/crewName/defaultName", "value": "${title}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 3. Configure the shield Expand energyShieldInfo and set duration = 10, armor = 200, distance = 15 and sizeScale = (1,1,1). shieldType defaults to Box; alternatives are Sphere and the later Custom example. The image shows the final custom configuration. The position follows the turret position plus forward * distance. Box follows the turret's facing; Custom uses isCustomModelFacingForward to control this. After loading, the code binds a shield armor group, assigns the configured Armor to its hitBoxes and marks them as intermittent armor. Removal unbinds that group and returns the resource. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/upgradableSkillContents/0/skills/0/crewSkillRef/displayValue/crewSkill/energyShieldInfo", "value": "{\"duration\":10,\"armor\":200,\"distance\":15,\"sizeScale\":{\"x\":1,\"y\":1,\"z\":1},\"shieldType\":0}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/upgradableSkillContents/0/skills/0/crewSkillRef/SetValue", "args": [ "@asset:${asset}/upgradableSkillContents/0/skills/0/crewSkillRef/displayValue" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/crewName/defaultName", "value": "${title}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 4. Configure a custom prefab and resource name This example copies the official EnergyShield.prefab to Tutorial_Shield.prefab. Preserve EnergyShieldMonoComponent on its root. Check that aabb references VehicleHitBoxAABBComponent and hitBoxes references valid shield HitBox components. Preserve those bindings and colliders when replacing the art. Missing references are not a valid shield setup. Create ManualNameBuildPiplineData. In bundleNameMaps, assign the prefab to bundleObject and use a name plus variant for bundleName, such as tutorial-shield-shared.prefab. Add this naming asset to ModPackageBuildPiplineData.linkedObjects. The current collector splits the name at dots; the example uses exactly one dot. Set shieldType = Custom and copy the same complete resource name into customModel. It is a runtime resource key, not a project file path. isCustomModelFacingForward defaults to true. The recipe creates a distinct key per run to avoid teaching-package collisions. manual/en/mod/spg-td-hydraulic-suspensio.title: Configure SPG, tank destroyer, and Strv hydraulic suspension actions | Panzer War Document
manual/en/mod/spg-td-hydraulic-suspensio.summary: Configure SPG, tank destroyer, and Strv hydraulic suspension actions 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run spg-td-hydraulic-suspension --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "vehicle": "${fixture}/Tutorial_TurretVehicle.asset", "shared": "${fixture}/Tutorial_SharedTurret.asset", "spg": "${fixture}/Tutorial_SPG.asset", "td": "${fixture}/Tutorial_TD.asset", "strv": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Hydraulic.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } Choose a turret action for the main turret in VehicleTextData. This example uses separate tutorial assets to demonstrate TD, SPG, and Strv configurations and how SharedTurretData takes precedence. 1. Create the turret action assets In the Project window, choose Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Turret Action - 炮塔逻辑. Create TD - 反坦, SPG - 火炮, and Hydraulic - 液压 assets named Tutorial_TD, Tutorial_SPG, and Tutorial_Hydraulic. A turret parameter has one actionData slot. The TD asset enables hull steering assistance and has no extra settings. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.SPGTurretAction)", "${spg}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.TDTurretAction)", "${td}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.StrvTurretAction)", "${strv}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. Set the SPG aiming parameter Select Tutorial_SPG and set maxDistance to 450. The value is used when updating the overhead camera and calculating the fallback trajectory preview duration for an unreachable target. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${spg}/maxDistance", "value": "450" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 3. Set the Strv hydraulic parameters Select Tutorial_Hydraulic. Keep the three attack-mode speed modifiers at their defaults and set the suspension and automatic control fields below. Field Value attackingSuspension 0.5 wheelElevateClamp 0.45 maxElevateAnglePerSecond 0.1 autoPidFactors (3, 0, 2.5) Unity takes the absolute value of the first three fields during asset validation and caps wheelElevateClamp at attackingSuspension. The hydraulic action requires a tracked chassis with TrackController and working road wheels. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${strv}/attackingSuspension", "value": "0.5" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${strv}/wheelElevateClamp", "value": "0.45" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${strv}/maxElevateAnglePerSecond", "value": "0.1" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${strv}/autoPidFactors", "value": "3,0,2.5" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 4. Assign the main turret action Open a copy of VehicleTextData. Clear sharedTurretData and assign Tutorial_TD to MTParameter.actionData, then switch it to Tutorial_SPG. To reuse a turret configuration, open a copy of SharedTurretData, set turretParameter.actionData to Tutorial_Hydraulic, and assign the shared asset to the vehicle's sharedTurretData. The main turret takes its parameters from the shared asset when one is assigned. The Inspector then hides the local MTParameter. Each simple fire-control system reads its own turret parameters. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar_VehicleTextData.asset", "${vehicle}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar-SharedTurret.asset", "${shared}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/sharedTurretData", "value": "null" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/MTParameter/actionData", "value": "@asset:${td}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetTurretParam()/actionData/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_TD" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/MTParameter/actionData", "value": "@asset:${spg}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetTurretParam()/actionData/maxDistance" }, "expect": { "contains": "450" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${shared}/turretParameter/actionData", "value": "@asset:${strv}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/sharedTurretData", "value": "@asset:${shared}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 5. Save and verify the action references After saving, confirm that the local actionData still points to Tutorial_SPG. With the shared asset assigned, the effective action should be Tutorial_Hydraulic with a wheelElevateClamp of 0.45. This example verifies references and values in the editor. Test hull steering, suspension travel, and aiming on a fully assembled vehicle. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetTurretParam()/actionData/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_Hydraulic" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetTurretParam()/actionData/wheelElevateClamp" }, "expect": { "contains": "0.45" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/MTParameter/actionData/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_SPG" } } ]

manual/en/mod/tank-shell-ejection-animat.title: Create a tank shell ejection animation | Panzer War Document
manual/en/mod/tank-shell-ejection-animat.summary: Create a tank shell ejection animation 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run tank-shell-ejection-animation --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "rig": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellRig.fbx", "model": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellRig.prefab", "clip": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellEject.anim", "script": "${fixture}/PlayAnimationComponent.lua" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } Adapted from 樱花's original tank shell ejection tutorial. Build the casing and ejection mechanism under the turret in Blender, author the clip in Unity, then bind playback to the firing event in Lua. 1. Prepare and import the model In Blender, place the casing inside the turret and parent it to the turret. The example names the casing Casing. Set the ejection mechanism's pivot at its center of rotation. If the rotation axis differs from the global axes, add an empty, orient it to the local axis, and parent the mechanism to it. The example calls this empty MechanismPivot. Export an FBX and import it into Unity. Confirm that it contains Turret/Casing and Turret/MechanismPivot, then create a prefab for the setup. The recipe builds and exports the sample using Blender in background mode. If Unity cannot find Blender, set BLENDER to its executable before starting the editor. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/ExportRig", "args": [ "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellRig.fbx" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/EnsureRigPrefab", "args": [ "${rig}", "${model}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Turret/Casing/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String) Casing" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Turret/MechanismPivot/Mechanism/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String) Mechanism" } } ] 2. Author and assign the animation Select the prefab root in Unity's Animation window and create Tutorial_ShellEject.anim. Add three keyframes to the casing's local Position for rest, ejection and return. The example moves the casing 0.35 units on local X at 0.2 seconds and returns it to its start at 0.4 seconds. The local Rotation curves on MechanismPivot open the mechanism by 35° at 0.2 seconds and then return it to rest. Set the clip to Legacy and leave its Wrap Mode at Default. Add Animation to the root, assign the default clip and turn off Play Automatically so Lua can start it. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/WriteClip", "args": [ "${fixture}", "${model}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Turret/Casing/m_LocalPosition.x: 3 keys" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/AssignClip", "args": [ "${model}", "${clip}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellEject" } } ] 3. Bind the firing event Add LuaBehaviorMono to the same root. Save this script as PlayAnimationComponent.lua and assign it to Behavior. manual/en/mod/track-ik-suspension.html.summary: Set up a Track IK suspension arm 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run track-ik-suspension --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "model": "${fixture}/Tutorial_TrackIK.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } TrackIK rotates a suspension arm as its road wheel moves. This example uses one arm and one road wheel in the same model prefab. 1. Prepare the model hierarchy Separate the suspension arm into its own node and put its pivot at the hull connection. Add SuspensionArm and RoadWheel under MainBody. Add an empty StandardUCS node in the same prefab and align its up and right axes to the hull. Place the wheel forward of the arm pivot. The example wheel's local position is (0, -0.25, 1). Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "create", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform", "children": [ "MainBody/SuspensionArm", "MainBody/RoadWheel", "StandardUCS" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "update", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform", "child": "MainBody/RoadWheel", "values": { "m_LocalPosition": { "x": 0, "y": -0.25, "z": 1 } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Configure TrackIK Add TrackIK to SuspensionArm. Set Target Wheel to RoadWheel and Standard UCS to StandardUCS. The example uses a Height of 0.1 and a Flip Sign of 1. Leave Use Transform Wrapper enabled. In game, the wrapper at the pivot points its local Z+ toward the target direction while preserving the mesh's initial placement relative to the wrapper. With the wrapper disabled, the script rotates the arm directly, so the arm model's Z+ should point forward along the arm. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.TrackIK", "child": "MainBody/SuspensionArm", "values": { "isFlip": 1, "height": 0.1, "useTransformWrapper": true }, "references": [ { "property": "target", "child": "MainBody/RoadWheel", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform" }, { "property": "standardUCS", "child": "StandardUCS", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Save and verify Save the prefab and check both Transform references. Select the arm in the Scene view and use its guide line to confirm that it points to the intended road wheel. This example verifies the prefab references and settings. Check the rotation and height offset while driving the complete vehicle. manual/en/mod/vehicle-dev-qa.html.title: Troubleshoot a vehicle mod | Panzer War Document
manual/en/mod/vehicle-dev-qa.html.summary: Troubleshoot a vehicle mod 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-dev-qa Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_VehicleQA.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(String)" } } ] } A vehicle fails to load Check the installation folder and platform in mod installation. Find the first error in the runtime log and confirm that the package links to the right build pipeline. If the vehicle loads but behaves incorrectly, use VehicleTextData to check vehicle data, hitboxes, tracks, shells, engine sounds and firing sounds. The gun cannot elevate or depress For ordinary guns, use positive magnitudes for Elevate Angle and Depression Angle. For example, UpMaxDegree = 20 and DownMaxDegree = 8 give a range of -8° to 20°. Check the shared turret data and any directional override. maxTurretPositiveAngle and maxTurretNegativeAngle control horizontal traverse. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/Editor/DocumentationSamples/vehicle-text-data/Tutorial_VehicleTextData.asset", "${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/sharedTurretData", "value": "null" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/MTParameter/UpMaxDegree", "value": "20" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/MTParameter/DownMaxDegree", "value": "8" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetTurretParam()/UpMaxDegree" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single) 20" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetTurretParam()/DownMaxDegree" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single) 8" } } ] Handling, suspension and rendering For handling problems, check mass, wheel colliders and suspension using the wheeled vehicle guide. For invisible models, check materials, Renderers and layers in the rendering guide. Set normal textures to Normal Map in Unity. Use Blender's Face Orientation overlay to check mesh faces when needed. A secondary turret reports an index error Check that the error in the log refers to shell data, then verify the bulletData references and selected index for each secondary turret. Compare against the vehicle modding notes and the template vehicle.

manual/en/mod/vehicle-hatches.html.title: Vehicle Hatch Configuration Tutorial | Panzer War Document
manual/en/mod/vehicle-hatches.html.summary: Vehicle Hatch Configuration Tutorial 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-hatches --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Hatch.prefab", "sourceMesh": "${fixture}/Tutorial_HatchSource.obj" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This tutorial uses a separate Tutorial_Hatch.prefab to show hatch markers, moving parts and double-sided meshes. The example contains teaching nodes and a mesh rather than a complete vehicle. Field spellings match the source. 1. Add and register the component Add VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent to the hatch object and expand hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment to edit its nested configuration. On the same object, configure VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent for runtime discovery: set attachmentSlotType to Specific and assign the hatch component to specificAttachmentMonoComponent. The project's CustomEditor adds this companion automatically; the recipe creates and saves it explicitly. Check that the companion references the current hatch component. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": {} } }, "children": [ "HatchCenter", "LeftHand", "RightHand", "HatchPivot", "HatchPivot/HatchMesh" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "attachmentSlotType": 1 }, "references": [ { "property": "specificAttachmentMonoComponent", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Hatch centre, hand markers and hinge hatchRadius=0.5; hatchTransform is the hatch opening centre. leftHandSlotTransform and rightHandSlotTransform are hand placement markers, not the moving hinge or pivot. The moving pivot is each activeParts entry's activePartTransform: assign the independent moving pivot to activePartTransform with identity initial local rotation. Expected check: the hatch centre sits at the opening, hand markers are not used as hinges, and the pivot starts at identity rotation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "hatchRadius": 0.5 } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.hatchTransform", "child": "HatchCenter" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.leftHandSlotTransform", "child": "LeftHand" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.rightHandSlotTransform", "child": "RightHand" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Configure movement isSemiOpen=false shows activeParts. Each entry uses axis=(1,0,0), activeAngle=90, closeAngle=0, moveSpeed=120. At runtime localRotation=Quaternion.AngleAxis(angle,axis) overwrites the local rotation; it does not add a delta. isSemiOpen is a state or display condition; setting it does not guarantee runtime code disables existing activeParts animation. Expected check: the pivot starts at identity rotation, so the result does not depend on the original orientation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "isSemiOpen": false, "activeParts": [ { "axis": { "x": 1, "y": 0, "z": 0 }, "activeAngle": 90, "closeAngle": 0, "moveSpeed": 120 } ] } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.activeParts.Array.data[0].activePartTransform", "child": "HatchPivot" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. Save and check Verify the component, pivots and movement values, including the runtime discovery condition. Save the prefab and read back the moving pivot reference, moveSpeed and companion type. In-game opening, crew hand placement and complete vehicle loading still require runtime verification. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/attachmentSlotType" }, "expect": { "contains": "Specific" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/activePartTransform/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "HatchPivot" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/moveSpeed" }, "expect": { "contains": "120" } } ] 5. Bake double-sided meshes when needed If an open hatch needs visible backfaces, assign the relevant MeshFilter entries to doubleSidedMeshFilters. In the vehicle attachment configuration editor, click the double-sided mesh bake button and choose an output folder under Assets. doubleSidedMeshes is generated output, not a list to fill manually. Limit this to the moving regions that need backfaces to avoid doubling the entire vehicle's triangle count. The recipe demonstrates the input and output references with a separately copied quad mesh. It calls the same baker with an explicit output folder, bypassing the interactive folder dialog. Repeated baking updates generated meshes while preserving GUIDs. Temporarily enabled source Read/Write settings are restored afterwards. This verifies mesh data and references, not the final rendered appearance. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/Light/AuthoringSamples/Square.obj", "${sourceMesh}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "UnityEngine.MeshFilter", "child": "HatchPivot/HatchMesh", "references": [ { "property": "m_Mesh", "asset": "${sourceMesh}", "type": "UnityEngine.Mesh" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "doubleSidedMeshFilters": [ {} ] } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.doubleSidedMeshFilters.Array.data[0]", "child": "HatchPivot/HatchMesh", "component": "UnityEngine.MeshFilter" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.VehicleHatchMeshBaker/BakePrefab", "args": [ "${asset}", "", "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "_DoubleSided_" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/doubleSidedMeshes/Length" }, "expect": { "contains": "1" } } ]

manual/en/mod/vehicle-light-component.ht.summary: VehicleLightAttachment Guide 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-light-component --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Light.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This example configures a circular low-beam light. VehicleLightAttachment is serialized configuration data; VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent is the component attached to a GameObject. Field names keep their original C# identifiers. 1. Create the component and bind the object Create a light object in the vehicle prefab and add VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent. Expand lightAttachmentSlot, then attachment, and assign the light origin to lightTransform. This example uses a separate Tutorial_Light.prefab with a node named LightOrigin. The same object needs VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent for runtime discovery. Set attachmentSlotType to Specific and assign the light component to specificAttachmentMonoComponent. The project's CustomEditor adds this companion when drawing the light Inspector; the recipe creates and saves it explicitly. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": {} } }, "children": [ "LightOrigin" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "attachmentSlotType": 1 }, "references": [ { "property": "specificAttachmentMonoComponent", "child": "", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "references": [ { "property": "lightAttachmentSlot.attachment.lightTransform", "child": "LightOrigin" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Shape and size Set the shape to Circle. Circle and HalfCircle show radiusSize; this example uses 0.3. Rectangles use rectSize instead, and CustomShape uses customShapeRenderers; the existing Light/AuthoringSamples assets are a reference. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "lightSizeType": 0, "radiusSize": 0.3 } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Appearance and visibility Set lightType to LowBeam, baseColor to white, and emissionColor to HDR white with intensity 3.5 as in this example. Keep isAlwaysVisible = true and isBlinker = false, and turn off isAutoNaming. Enabling isBlinker reveals frequency and phase fields. The defaults, blinkerFrequency = 1 and blinkerStep = 0.5, are examples rather than the only working values. lensEmitters contains lens-glare sampling nodes, up to eight entries; beamOrigin specifies a separate beam origin. Leave both empty for this basic Circle setup. These fields are distinct from Unity Light components. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "lightType": 0, "baseColor": { "r": 1, "g": 1, "b": 1, "a": 1 }, "emissionColor": { "r": 3.5, "g": 3.5, "b": 3.5, "a": 1 }, "isAlwaysVisible": true, "isBlinker": false, "isAutoNaming": false } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. Verify Check the object binding to lightTransform, that the companion runtime components were saved, that the Circle radius and colors were written, and that lensEmitters has at most 8 entries; Inspector screenshots show field locations and values, not runtime behavior, so look at the light in game once as well. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/attachmentSlotType" }, "expect": { "contains": "Specific" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/specificAttachmentMonoComponent" }, "expect": { "contains": "--- VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent ---" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent)/lightAttachmentSlot/attachment/lightTransform/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "LightOrigin" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent)/lightAttachmentSlot/attachment/radiusSize" }, "expect": { "contains": "0.3" } } ]

manual/en/mod/zoom-ratio-config.html.title: Configure Vehicle Zoom Ratios | Panzer War Document
manual/en/mod/zoom-ratio-config.html.summary: Configure Vehicle Zoom Ratios 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run zoom-ratio-config --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ZoomProfile.asset", "vehicle": "${fixture}/Tutorial_VehicleTextData.asset", "gun": "${fixture}/Tutorial_SharedGun.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This tutorial sets the binocular and sight zoom ratio ranges of a vehicle with a ZoomProfileData asset. Field names are kept exactly as they appear in the source. 1. Create a ZoomProfileData asset In the Project window choose Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Base - 载具配置 > Zoom - 倍率 to create a ZoomProfileData asset. Expand Zoom Name (zoomName) and set Default Name to Tutorial Zoom. This example uses separate teaching assets and leaves existing vehicle configurations untouched. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.ZoomProfileData)", "${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/zoomName/defaultName", "value": "Tutorial Zoom" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. Set the zoom ratio range minRatio defaults to 1.9 and maxRatio defaults to 3.5. Use positive ratios and keep minRatio less than or equal to maxRatio; this is an author constraint, with no validation here in code. The example sets minRatio = 2 and maxRatio = 8 as the low and high endpoints. At runtime these two values become the available ratio range: BaseVehiclePawn.GetZoomRatio reads minRatio and maxRatio from binocularZoomProfileData for binocular zoom and from zoomProfileData for sight zoom, and falls back to built-in ranges when the asset is null. VehicleCameraZoom then converts the ratio into a horizontal field of view and interpolates within that range. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/minRatio", "value": "2" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/maxRatio", "value": "8" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/minRatio" }, "expect": { "contains": "2" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/maxRatio" }, "expect": { "contains": "8" } } ] 3. Vision override and thermal vision Enable Is Vision Override (isVisionOverride) to reveal Is Thermal Vision (isThermalVision). Both default to false; this example sets both to true. A runtime thermal lock can still disable thermal vision, so the setting does not guarantee an unconditional in-game effect. If you do not want to change the vision mode, keep both flags false; the zoom ratios still apply. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isVisionOverride", "value": "true" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isThermalVision", "value": "true" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isThermalVision" }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } } ] 4. Assign it to vehicle parameters Choose the reference slot by purpose: binoculars use VehicleTextData.PSParameter.binocularZoomProfileData; the sight uses zoomProfileData on the active gun parameters. With sharedGunData, set tankFireParameter.zoomProfileData on that asset. Without a shared reference, set TFParameter.zoomProfileData on the vehicle. The same profile asset can be assigned to both slots. Save the parameter assets and read the references back. This recipe verifies editor assets and references; in-game FOV, thermal effects and mod loading remain unverified. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Assigning a live object is equivalent to dragging the profile into a reference slot. This sample creates separate parameter assets and reads the references back; camera and thermal effects are not verified in game. manual/gameplay/map-editor-tutorial.html.title: 6. 地图编辑器使用教程 Map Editor Tutorial | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/map-editor-tutorial.html.summary: 6. 地图编辑器使用教程 Map Editor Tutorial 案例地图分享码： Share code of the example map: c564f128-6d1b-4db5-84a2-953b1de0d52c -[Map]-[simplemap] 地图制作注意事项 Notes on Making a Map 必须包含 Tag，TeamAStartPoint（A 队出生点）与 TeamBStartPoint（B 队出生点）之间应保持一定距离。 使用空气墙组件，拉伸模型以围住地图边缘。 警惕 Z-Fighting 引起的抖动，避免模型完全重叠，否则会导致模型闪烁。 The map must contain the tags TeamAStartPoint (Team A spawn point) and TeamBStartPoint (Team B spawn point), and they should be placed a certain distance apart from each other. Use the air wall component and stretch its model to enclose the edges of the map. Beware of the flickering caused by Z-Fighting. Do not let models overlap completely, otherwise they will flicker back and forth. 运行时可能遇到的问题 Possible Issues at Runtime 无法出生。设置的 Tag 数量过少或距离过近。 远距离看不见自己摆放的小细节物体。出于优化考虑，仅在工坊中显示所有物体，运行时会根据 LOD 策略选择物体的细节等级。 Unable to spawn. Too few tags were set, or they are placed too close to each other. Small detail objects you placed are not visible from a distance. For optimization reasons, all objects are displayed only in the workshop; at runtime the level of detail of an object is chosen according to the LOD policy.

manual/gameplay/ravenfield-map-support.h.title: 7. Ravenfield 地图模组支持 Ravenfield Map Tool Support | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/ravenfield-map-support.h.summary: 7. Ravenfield 地图模组支持 Ravenfield Map Tool Support 版权合规 Copyrights 注意，请勿将没有版权的 Ravenfield 地图提交到我们游戏的创意工坊，我们会立刻进行删除处理。在使用此功能前，请确保你拥有正版的 Ravenfield。 如果你是 Ravenfield 的地图所有者，我们欢迎你将你的 Ravenfield 地图直接提交到装甲纷争的创意工坊！ Attention! You are not allowed to submit a Ravenfield map to our workshop if you do not have the copyright. And please be sure you have owned Ravenfield in Steam first! If you are the owner of the Ravenfield map, you are welcome to submit it to our workshop!!! 介绍 Description 针对 Steam 的普通版，我们增加了对 Ravenfield 创意工坊的支持。 For Panzer War : Lit on Steam, we add support for Mod tool maps from Ravenfield. Step.1 如何获取 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图？How to get Ravenfield Mod maps? 打开 Ravenfield 的创意工坊 https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=636480&requiredtags[]=Maps+-+Mod+Tools，订阅 Mod Tool 的 Mod 地图，然后在本地的 SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\636480 路径找到对应的 rfl 文件，此文件即为 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图。 Open the workshop of Ravenfield. https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=636480&requiredtags[]=Maps+-+Mod+Tools Subscribe Mod Tool Maps. Then you can find rfl files from SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\636480. Step.2 如何给装甲纷争安装 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图 How to install it for Panzer War? 将 Ravenfield 的 rfl 结尾的地图，放在 SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\Mods\StandaloneWindows64_RvlMaps 路径下，即可使用 Ravenfield 创意工坊的 Mod 地图。同时，在游戏启动后，会在地图文件路径处生成一份 Yaml，可用于自定义出生点以及寻路点的坐标。 Place rfl files to SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\Mods\StandaloneWindows64_RvlMaps. Then open the game. A yaml file will be created after game is opened, you can change the yaml to custom the spawn points and patrol points. Q&A 如果出生点出生在异常位置，请使用进阶配置，调整自定义出生点。 If the start point is wrong, please use custom points. 部分地图会导致游戏 Crash。 Some maps will crash game. 进阶：如何配置自定义出生点 Advance: Configure custom points 在放完 rfl 文件后，重新启动一次游戏。即会在 rfl 同目录下，生成一个 yaml 文件。 将 isCustomPoints 的 false 改为 true，修改下方 x,y,z 坐标为想要的位置。 Config the yaml file created in step.2 # @Comment: 是否自定义出生点 @Type: System.Boolean isCustomPoints: false # @Comment: A 队出生点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customTeamASpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: B 队出生点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customTeamBSpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: 寻路点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customPartolPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: 寻路烘培参数 @Type: System.Int32 tileSize: 512 # @Comment: 寻路烘培参数 @Type: System.Single voxelSize: 2 可添加多个出生点以及寻路点，如下图所示。 customTeamASpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 - x: -4 y: 0 z: -4 - x: 4 y: 0 z: 4 进阶：如何打包为 ModPackage Advance: Pack it as a ModPackage 将 rfl 与对应 yaml 文件用 zip 形式进行压缩，然后将后缀从 zip 改为 mod package，将文件命名改为 StandaloneWindows64_任意名称.modpack，即可随地图与出生点配置信息分享给其他人。 Compress the rfl file and its matching yaml file into a zip archive, then change the extension from zip to mod package and rename the file to StandaloneWindows64_AnyName.modpack. You can then share the map together with its spawn point configuration with other people.

manual/mod/continuous-build.html.title: 18. 持续构建（脚本化构建模组） Continuous Build (Scripted Mod Building) | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/continuous-build.html.summary: 18. 持续构建（脚本化构建模组） Continuous Build (Scripted Mod Building) 创建持续构建流程，可以更快地迭代更新模组文件。你可以高度自定义打包哪些模组以及将其拷贝至哪个文件夹，全程无需手动操作，也无需打开 Unity 点击任何按钮。 Setting up a continuous build pipeline lets you iterate on Mod files faster. You can freely customize which Mods are built and which folder they are copied to, without doing anything by hand and without opening Unity to click any button. 1. 创建一个 manifest 描述 json Create a manifest json modNames 为一个数组，填写你要构建的模组包列表。 modNames is an array; fill in the list of mod packages you want to build. copyInfo 会根据平台，将最终生成的文件拷贝到指定目录。（安卓工程则只拷贝安卓文件，Windows 工程则只拷贝 Windows 文件） copyInfo copies the generated files to the given directory according to the platform. (An Android project only copies the Android files, a Windows project only copies the Windows files.) isPackage 为 true 则拷贝 modpackage；为 false 则拷贝 buildpipline 原始资源（用于上传 Steam 创意工坊）。 When isPackage is true the modpackage file is copied; when it is false the raw buildpipline assets are copied instead (these are the ones you upload to the Steam Workshop). 案例 TestBuildPipline.json Example TestBuildPipline.json 构建模组包 BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes 与 BuildPipline-Vehicles，生成 modpackage 文件。 将安卓平台资源拷贝至 D:/Projects/Android-Ship，将电脑平台资源拷贝至 D:/Projects/Windows-Ship。 Build the mod packages BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes and BuildPipline-Vehicles into modpackage files. Copy the Android assets to D:/Projects/Android-Ship and the desktop assets to D:/Projects/Windows-Ship. { "infos": [ { "modNames": [ "BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes", "BuildPipline-Vehicles" ], "copyInfo": [ { "platform": "Android", "dstDir": "D:/Projects/Android-Ship" }, { "platform": "StandaloneWindows64", "dstDir": "D:/Projects/Windows-Ship" } ], "isPackage" : true } ] } 2. CI 脚本 CI Script 调用 ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest，传入 -config 参数（manifest 路径）。 Call ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest and pass the -config argument (the path of the manifest). 案例 BuildPiplineCI.sh Example BuildPiplineCI.sh projectDir 为你的 Unity 项目路径。 projectDir is the path of your Unity project. manifestDir 为步骤 1 中 manifest 的 json 文件路径。 manifestDir is the path of the manifest json file from step 1. editorDir 为你的 Unity 安装路径。 editorDir is the path where Unity is installed. logPath 为你的打包日志输出路径。 logPath is the output path of the build log. （在 Windows 上执行 bash，可安装 Git，然后通过 Git Bash 执行以下脚本。） (To run bash on Windows, install git and then run the following script through git bash.) projectDir="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP" manifestDir="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP\CLI\BuildPiplineCI\TestBuildPipline.json" editorDir="H:\UnityEditor\2021.3.0f1\Editor\Unity.exe" logPath="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP\CLI\BuildPiplineCI\log.txt" $editorDir -projectPath $projectDir -batchmode -quit -executeMethod ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest -config $manifestDir -logFile $logPath 完整的构建案例，可直接查看 PanzerWar-Mods\UnityProject\BuildPiplineCI 文件夹。 调整 BuildPiplineCI.sh 中的路径为你自己项目的路径，用 Git Bash 方式执行即可。 For a complete build example, look at the PanzerWar-Mods\UnityProject\BuildPiplineCI folder. Change the paths in BuildPiplineCI.sh to the ones of your own project and run it through git bash. 3. Jenkins 集成 Jenkins Integration Jenkins 安装与配置教程 4. 特殊情况 Special Cases 1. BuildPipline 位于 ModManager 的子文件夹 BuildPipline in a Subfolder of ModManager 在这种情况下，设置 modNames 名称时，也需要加上前缀。 In this case the name you write in modNames has to carry the prefix as well. 例如，模组位于 Assets/ModManager/**AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX**。 For example, for a Mod located at Assets/ModManager/AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX 则填写 **AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX**。 you write AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX.

manual/mod/create-mech.html.title: 05. Create Mech 创建机甲 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/create-mech.html.summary: 05. Create Mech 创建机甲 在阅读本文档之前，请务必具备普通坦克模组的开发经验。 Before reading this document, make sure you already have experience developing a normal tank Mod. 前期准备 Preparation 1. 模型 Model 骨骼模型：一个绑定骨骼的机甲模型。 Skeletal model: a mech model with a rigged skeleton. 伤害模型：一个将各个关节分离的简易伤害模型。 Damage model: a simple damage model with each joint separated. 2. 动画 Animation 你至少需要拥有以下动画： 待机动画 走路动画：笔直向前走路动画，向左的走路动画，向右的走路动画，原地左转的动画，和原地向右的动画。 You need at least the following animations: Idle animation Walking animations: walking straight forward, walking to the left, walking to the right, turning left in place, and turning right in place. 注：倒退走路动画可以在动画树中，以 -1 倍的速度播放，实现倒退。 Note: the backward walking animation can be produced by playing the animation at -1x speed in the animator controller. 你可以额外制作以下动画： 飞行动画：飞行起步动画，飞行中待机动画，和飞行结束落地动画。 You can additionally create the following animations: Flight animations: the take-off animation, the in-flight idle animation, and the landing animation at the end of the flight. 3. 导入引擎动画的设置 Animation Import Settings 动画导入引擎后，需进行相关设置，才能使机甲符合物理模拟效果。 After the animations are imported into the engine, a few settings are required so the mech matches the physics simulation. 勾选 Root Transform Position (Y) 中的 Bake Into Pose。 Tick Bake Into Pose under Root Transform Position (Y). 在 Curves 中增加 GravityWeight 属性，并将曲线设置为值为 1 的水平线。 Add a GravityWeight property under Curves, and set the curve to a horizontal line with a value of 1. 在包含脚步落地帧的动画中，于 Events 中添加 WalkSound 事件。 On the animation frames where a foot touches the ground, add a WalkSound event under Events. 载具属性设置 Vehicle Property Setup 机甲预制体制作 Building the Mech Prefab 动画控制器。在含有 Animator 组件的物体上增加 MechAnimatorController 组件和 CharacterController 组件。 Animator controller. On the object that holds the Animator component, add the MechAnimatorController component and the CharacterController component. 物理碰撞。调整 CharacterController 的属性，使胶囊体底部与脚底一致。 Physics collision. Adjust the CharacterController properties so that the bottom of the capsule lines up with the soles of the feet. 机甲脚底碰撞。在机甲两个脚底均增加 MechLegEndPoint 组件和 BoxCollider 组件，并勾选 BoxCollider 的 isTrigger 属性。若机甲可以飞行，则增加 MechFireBurst 组件，并调整相应参数。 Mech foot collision. Add a MechLegEndPoint component and a BoxCollider component to both of the mech's feet, and tick the isTrigger property on the BoxCollider. If the mech can fly, also add the MechFireBurst component and adjust its parameters. 炮塔同步。增加 Turret/Gun/Dym 的空物体。在机甲模型上，于上半身旋转控制的位置增加 MechTurretSync 组件，以同步相应位置。 Turret sync. Create empty objects for Turret/Gun/Dym. On the mech model, add the MechTurretSync component at the position that drives the upper-body rotation, so the corresponding positions stay in sync. 动画树制作 Building the Animator Controller 在 Project 中新增 Animator Controller，并将其拖入机甲预制体含 Animator 的组件上。 Create a new Animator Controller in the Project window and drag it onto the Animator component of the mech prefab. 增加如下参数。类型一定要与图中一致。 Add the parameters shown below. The types must match the picture exactly. 增加动画状态。若含飞行的三个状态动画，则一定要与图中的三个 Jet 开头的动画命名一致。 Add the animation states. If you include the three flight state animations, their names must match the three Jet-prefixed animation names in the picture. 向前走路（Walk）由多个动画的混合组成（Blend Tree）。混合使用的参数为 Turn。0.5 为笔直向前的动画，0 为向左的走路动画，1 为向右的走路动画。可以在中间插入更多动画作补帧，使动画更加自然。 Walking forward (Walk) is a blend of several animations (a Blend Tree). The blend parameter is Turn: 0.5 is the straight-forward animation, 0 is the walk-left animation, and 1 is the walk-right animation. You can insert more animations in between to fill in the motion and make it look more natural. 注：倒退动画可以在动画树中，以 -1 倍的速度播放，实现倒退。 Note: the backward animation can be produced by playing the animation at -1x speed in the animator controller. 动画转换条件。在下图出现的连线，需要增加如图的条件。 Transition conditions. The transitions shown in the pictures below need the conditions shown in those pictures. 向前走路动画条件 Walk forward condition: 向后走路动画条件 Walk backward condition: 向左走路动画条件 Walk left condition: 向右走路动画条件 Walk right condition: 若含飞行动画，则飞行落地动画条件 If you include flight animations, the flight landing condition: 从 Idle 转到其他状态，无需设置 Has Exit Time。其他状态转到 Idle，则需要设置 Has Exit Time。 Transitions from Idle to other states do not need Has Exit Time. Transitions from other states back to Idle do need Has Exit Time. 注意：游戏的输入为 Walk 与 Turn。Walk 的范围为 -1 到 1，Turn 的范围为 0 到 1。可以根据自己的动画，设置更加复杂的动画切换。动画系统的条件切换可以在引擎内直接进行调试，可访问 Unity 动画教程了解更多详情。 Note: the game's inputs are Walk and Turn. Walk ranges from -1 to 1, and Turn ranges from 0 to 1. You can set up more complex animation transitions to suit your own animations. Animation transition conditions can be debugged directly inside the engine — see the Unity animation tutorials for more details. 创建 VehicleData Creating VehicleData 像普通坦克一样，创建载具配置参数。然后删除生成的 VehicleTrack 文件。 Create the vehicle configuration parameters just like you would for a normal tank, then delete the generated VehicleTrack file. 其他配置信息和坦克一样进行配置即可。 All the other configuration can be done exactly the same way as for a tank. 在 VehicleTextData 中需要额外关注，设置机甲专用参数。 VehicleTextData needs extra attention: set the mech-specific parameters there.

manual/mod/custom-shader-data.html.summary: 32. Custom Shader Data 自定义着色器 32. Custom Shader Data 自定义着色器 Create Data 创建数据配置 Create the custom shader data from out menu. 如图所示，创建自定义着色器数据。 \ Pick your custom material. If you do not know about Unity material system, please search about the Unity material and shader graph tutorials. 选择自定义材质。如果不了解 Unity 的材质系统，请搜索 Unity Material 以及 Shader Graph 相关教程。 Config Component 配置组件 Add CoreRPMatComponent component to your model and toggle on is component based. You need to assign the guid from custom shader data to your component. Ensure the urp and hdrp should be different guids. 为模型添加 CoreRPMatComponent 组件，勾选“基于组件数据”，并将自定义着色器数据的 GUID 分配给该组件。请注意，URP 与 HDRP 需使用不同的 GUID，且材质文件需在不同的管线下打包。 Build 打包 If the shader is only for one vehicle, you can just put the CustomShaderData with VehicleInfo to pack. If it is for public resource purpose, you should pack it separately. 如果着色器仅用于单个载具，建议直接将 CustomShaderData 与 VehicleInfo 放在一起打包。如果是作为公共资源，则建议单独打包，并填写包依赖关系。 Advance 进阶知识 The logic behind custom shader data We use the custom material on your custom shader data and copy your material properties to the material you linked on CoreRPMatComponent. The material you linked will keep the following properties (They will not be overrided by your custom material). If you want to use the following properties you should keep the same name as the following table. 此功能原理： 我们使用自定义着色器数据中指定的自定义材质，并将其材质属性（包括各种勾选项和下拉框的值）覆盖到通过 CoreRPMatComponent 关联的材质上。 CoreRPMatComponent 关联的材质会保留以下属性（这些属性不会被自定义材质覆盖）。如果希望自定义着色器使用以下属性，请确保自定义着色器中的通道名称与下表保持一致。 Channel Name 通道名称 Type 类型 Description 介绍 _BaseMap Texture2d Diffuse map 漫反射贴图 _BumpMap Texture2d Normal map 法线贴图 _MaskMap Texture2d Mask map Unity URP 的 PBR 贴图 _Smoothness float Smoothness 光滑度 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT keyword Enable camouflage 是否启用涂装 _CamoPatternMap Texture2d Camouflage Pattern Map 涂装的样式图 _CamoPatternTiling Vector4 Camouflage Pattern Tiling 涂装的样式图的缩放比 _CamoBlackTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map back channel 黑色通道对应颜色 _CamoRedTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map red channel 红色通道对应颜色 _CamoGreenTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map green channel 绿色通道对应颜色 _CamoBlueTint Color4 Color stands for camouflage pattern map blue channel 蓝色通道对应颜色 _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO_COLOR_TEX keyword Enable texture camouflage 是否启用贴图的涂装 _Lerp float (Clamp in 0-1) Lerp between camouflage 涂装颜色占比 _DirtRange float (Clamp in 0-1) Lerp between dirty 污渍占比 _DirtTex Texture2d Dirt texture 污渍贴图 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT keyword Enable dirty 启用污渍贴图 Some Special Channel Usage 一些特殊通道的用法 _CamoPatternMap 涂装的样式图 Usage Split rgba channel and lerp with tint color 用法：提取 RGBA 通道，并使用 lerp 与 tint 颜色进行混合。 Vehicle Custom Shader 载具自定义着色器 Pick custom shader type as Custom Vehicle Option 着色器类型选择“自定义载具选项”。 Change the channel name to your name defined in shader. 将下方的通道名称更改为 Shader 中定义的名称。 How to support the dirt effect? 如何适配污渍效果？ When the _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT keyword is enabled, the vehicle's AO map is blended with _DirtTex at the strength given by _DirtRange. 当 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT 关键词启用时，载具的 AO 贴图将与 _DirtTex 按照 _DirtRange 指定的强度进行混合。

manual/mod/diy-to-mod.html.summary: 19. DIY-> Mod 工坊内容转模组 我希望所有人都能创造模组，制作模组不应仅限于拥有电脑和技术的人员。因此，工坊增加了发布 mod package 的功能。与分享码不同，分享的 mod package 是只读的，无法在工坊中编辑。 I hope everyone can create Mods — making a Mod should not be something only people with a PC and technical skills can do. That is why the workshop added the ability to publish a mod package. Unlike a share code, a shared mod package is read-only and cannot be edited in the workshop. 1. Create Content - 创建内容 在工坊点击发布后，会生成对应的 zip 与 mod package 文件。 文件位于以下路径： （电脑） SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\Mods\Export Package （手机）Android\data\com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM\files\Mods\Export Package When clicking share button in the workshop,the game will generate zip and mod package file. The file is located at （PC）SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\Mods\Export Package （Mobile）Android\data\com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM\files\Mods\Export Package 2. Sharing - 分享 Mod Package Mod package 文件可分享到各种社区、QQ 群或网盘。 Mod package files can be shared through communities, QQ groups and cloud storage. Mod.io zip 文件可用于上传至 https://pw.mod.io/add Mod package 文件可作为正常模组进行安装 zip file can be uploaded to https://pw.mod.io/add Mod package can be installed as normal Mod 3. Mod.io Upload - Mod.io 上传 upload zip file and click all platforms as approved 上传 zip 文件，并将所有平台勾选为 approved 国内访问 Mod.io 需要翻墙 Accessing Mod.io from mainland China requires a VPN.

manual/mod/encrypted-mods.html.title: 10. Encryption 加密模组 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/encrypted-mods.html.summary: 10. Encryption 加密模组 The encryption Mod is a way to encourage modders to create high quality Mods. You can only create the encryption Mods to player if you created your Mod without copyright issues. In other words, you can't use models from other games such as World of Tanks / War Thunder to make encryption Mods. If you make encryption Mods with copyright issues, the developer has rights to close your account and revoke all the keys you have generated. This agreement will affect all the mod package that is created after 2020/7/5. You can purchase models from CGTrader / Unity asset store and other cg stores to create encryption Mods. Or you can learn to create model on your own. 加密模组是一种鼓励模组制作者创造高质量模组的方式。只有在确保自己所制作的模组没有版权问题的情况下，才能为玩家创建加密模组。换句话说，你不能使用其他游戏（如《坦克世界》/《战争雷霆》）的模型来制作加密模组。如果你使用有版权问题的内容制作加密模组，开发者有权关闭你的账户并撤销你生成的所有密钥。该协议将影响 2020/7/5 之后创建的所有模组包。你可以从 CGTrader、Unity 资产商店及其他 CG 商店购买模型来制作加密模组，或者学习自己创建模型。 Enable Encryption in BuildPipline 在构建管线中启用加密 The Build-Pipline file will automatically generate key and iv for your package. 构建管线文件将自动为你的模组包生成密钥和 IV。 Create Mod Package 创建模组包 You can manage your paid Mod from 你可以从以下位置管理你的付费模组 https://game.windyverse.net/packagemanager To use this page, you need to apply for permission. Please send an email to message@windyverse.net and provide some of your works for our review. 此页面需要向我们申请资格才可以使用，请发送邮件至 message@windyverse.net，并提供一些你的作品以供我们审核。 Copy and Paste Key and IV from your mod package in to the web page. Qp+zqMYSnmFeLzYAY2BDK6AFMhmm4V1DAnoHoqgqPxE= 3MHPAwfwqCS9ZsC6UF+NLQ== Get Uid for ModPackage 获取 ModPackage 的 UID Set Uid for ModPackage 设置 ModPackage 的 UID After that, you can build the package as normal. 之后，你可以像往常一样构建模组包。 Manage CD-Key 管理激活码 Request CD-Key 申请激活码 Others 其他附加 Bundled Sub Mod Package 捆绑包 Mods now support bundling. For example, if Mod A is set to bundle the UIDs of Mods B and C, a user who activates Mod A automatically receives Mods B and C as well. You can also adjust the bundle of Mod A at any time, and the change is synchronized to users in real time. 模组现支持捆绑功能。例如，如果模组 A 设置捆绑了模组 B 和 C 的 UID，用户激活模组 A 后，将自动获得模组 B 和 C。你也可以随时调整模组 A 的捆绑设置，变更结果会实时同步给用户。 Payment Link 支付链接 Mods now support setting a payment link. Once a payment link is selected, it is shown directly on the Mod's guided unlock page. 模组现已支持设置支付链接。选择支付链接后，该链接将直接显示在模组的引导解锁页面上。 User Activation 用户激活

manual/mod/flight-vehicles.html.summary: 02.6 Flight 飞机 起落架动画控制器与动画 Landing Gear Animator Controller and Animations 动画准备 Preparing the Animations 需要使用 Animation 或者 Blender 等工具，制作三个飞机状态的动画。 You need to use Animation, Blender or a similar tool to key three aircraft state animations. 飞行中动画：起落架收起的常态 In-flight animation: the steady state with the landing gear retracted. 降落动画：起落架从收起到展开的过程 Landing animation: the transition of the landing gear from retracted to extended. 降落完毕动画：起落架展开的常态 Landing-complete animation: the steady state with the landing gear extended. 需要把动画绑定在显示模型上。 The animations must be keyed on the display model. 动画控制器准备 Preparing the Animator Controller 创建一份 Override 的动画控制器。 Create an Override animator controller. manual/mod/fmod-profiler.html.title: 26.4. Fmod Profiler | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/fmod-profiler.html.summary: 26.4. Fmod Profiler Profiler 是 FMOD Studio 中的一个实用工具，可实时查看 Unity 引擎中的音频事件、内存占用及 CPU 占用等信息。若要在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中连接 Unity 引擎，请遵循以下步骤： The Profiler is a utility in FMOD Studio that lets you watch the audio events, memory usage and CPU usage of the Unity engine in real time. To connect the Unity engine to the FMOD Studio Profiler, follow these steps. 打开 FMOD Studio：启动 FMOD Studio 并打开音频项目。 Open FMOD Studio: launch FMOD Studio and open your audio project. 打开 Profiler：在 FMOD Studio 的顶部菜单栏中，点击 "Window"，然后选择 "Profiler"。这将打开 Profiler 窗口。 Open the Profiler: in the top menu bar of FMOD Studio, click "Window" and then select "Profiler". This opens the Profiler window. 启动 Unity：确保 Unity 项目已打开，并在 Unity 中加载包含 FMOD 插件的场景。 Start Unity: make sure the Unity project is open and load the scene that contains the FMOD plugin. 设置连接：回到 Unity，点击顶部菜单栏中的 "FMOD"，然后选择 "Edit Settings"。在 Inspector 窗口中，展开 "Live Update" 部分，并勾选 "Enable Live Update"。确保 "Live Update Port" 与 FMOD Studio Profiler 中的端口设置相匹配（默认为 9264）。 Set up the connection: back in Unity, click "FMOD" in the top menu bar and select "Edit Settings". In the Inspector window, expand the "Live Update" section and tick "Enable Live Update". Make sure "Live Update Port" matches the port configured in the FMOD Studio Profiler (9264 by default). 激活实时更新：在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口中，点击 "Live Update" 按钮，确保其处于激活状态。激活后，按钮背景颜色应变为绿色。这将允许 FMOD Studio 与 Unity 引擎实时同步音频数据。 Activate live update: in the Profiler window of FMOD Studio, click the "Live Update" button and make sure it is active. Once active, the background of the button turns green. This lets FMOD Studio synchronize audio data with the Unity engine in real time. 连接 Profiler：现在，回到 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口。点击圆形的录制按钮。 Connect the Profiler: now go back to the Profiler window of FMOD Studio and click the round record button. 开始调试：现在，可以在 Unity 中运行场景。在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口中，可以实时查看 Unity 引擎中的音频事件、内存占用及 CPU 占用等信息，从而更好地分析和调试音量问题。 Start debugging: you can now run your scene in Unity. In the Profiler window of FMOD Studio you can watch the audio events, memory usage and CPU usage of the Unity engine in real time, which makes it easier to analyze and debug volume problems. 检查音效 Checking the Audio 在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中，可以通过以下方法对比并诊断音量问题： In the FMOD Studio Profiler you can compare and diagnose volume problems in the following ways. 检查事件的实时音量：在 Profiler 窗口的左侧栏中，可以查看正在播放的音频事件。选中其中一个事件，然后在右侧栏中查看该事件的实时音量数据。观察音量数据，检查是否存在异常波动或数值过低的情况。 Check the real-time volume of an event: the left panel of the Profiler window lists the audio events that are playing. Select one of them and the right panel shows its real-time volume data. Watch that data and check whether it fluctuates abnormally or is too low. 使用 Mixer 查看音量：在 FMOD Studio 的顶部菜单栏中，点击 "Window"，然后选择 "Mixer"。这将打开 Mixer 窗口。在 Mixer 中，可以查看不同总线的音量及其相互关系。请注意，如果 Profiler 中的 "Live Update" 已连接到 Unity，Mixer 也会显示实时音量数据。检查各个总线的音量，以确保其未低于预期值。 Use the Mixer to inspect volume: in the top menu bar of FMOD Studio, click "Window" and select "Mixer" to open the Mixer window. There you can see the volume of the different buses and how they relate to each other. Note that when "Live Update" in the Profiler is connected to Unity, the Mixer also shows real-time volume data. Check the volume of each bus to make sure none of them is lower than expected. 监听音频：在 Profiler 的 "Live Update" 已连接到 Unity 时，可以实时收听 Unity 中播放的音频。这样可以直接比较 FMOD Studio 和 Unity 中的音频效果，并判断音量是否存在问题。 Listen to the audio: while "Live Update" in the Profiler is connected to Unity, you can listen to the audio playing in Unity in real time. This lets you compare the result in FMOD Studio with the result in Unity directly and judge whether there is a volume problem. 记录并分析：在 Profiler 窗口中，可以点击 "Record" 按钮开始录制音频性能数据。录制完成后，可以详细分析音量、CPU 占用及内存占用等数据，以找出潜在问题。 Record and analyze: in the Profiler window you can click the "Record" button to start recording audio performance data. When the recording is finished you can analyze volume, CPU usage and memory usage in detail to find where the problem may be. 对比预期效果：如果有音频效果的预期结果（例如之前的录音或参考音频），可以将实时播放的音频与预期结果进行对比。这有助于判断音量是否有问题。 Compare against the expected result: if you have an expected result for the audio (for example an earlier recording or a reference track), you can compare the audio playing in real time against it. This helps you judge whether the volume is wrong. 通过上述方法，可以在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中对比并诊断音量问题。请注意，音量问题可能源于 FMOD 项目设置、音频文件的初始音量、Unity 中的音量设置等多种原因。在诊断问题时，请全面检查各个方面的设置。 With these methods you can compare and diagnose volume problems in the FMOD Studio Profiler. Keep in mind that a volume problem can come from many places: the FMOD project settings, the initial volume of the audio file, the volume settings in Unity, and so on. When diagnosing, check the settings on every side.

manual/mod/fmod-sound-debugging.html.title: 26.5. Fmod Sound Debugging Tool Fmod 音效调试工具 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/fmod-sound-debugging.html.summary: 26.5. Fmod Sound Debugging Tool Fmod 音效调试工具 在 Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.middlelayer/Tools/RuntimeDebugger/FmodPlayground.unity 目录下， 提供了一个 Fmod 音效调试场景，该环境与游戏真实环境逻辑保持一致。可用于快速调试不同距离下的 Fmod 音效。 The path above holds a scene for debugging Fmod audio. Its logic is kept consistent with the real in-game environment, so you can quickly test how an Fmod sound behaves at different distances. Firing Sound Debugging 开火音效调试 找到 FmodSoundDebugger 物体，选择 Bullet Sound，拖入自己的开火音效，然后点击运行。 Find the FmodSoundDebugger object, select Bullet Sound, drag in your own firing sound, and then click Play. 随后即可听到开火音效的循环播放。进入 Scene 窗口拖动该物体以改变其距离（例如 Z 值），即可测试不同距离下的音效强度。 You will then hear the firing sound play on a loop. Go into the Scene window and drag this object to change its distance — its z value, for example — to test how loud the sound is at different distances.
