manual/mod/install-vs-code-emmylua.html.title: 22.3 安装 VS Code 和配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Installing VS Code and Setting Up Emmy Lua | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/install-vs-code-emmylua.html.summary: 22.3 安装 VS Code 和配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Installing VS Code and Setting Up Emmy Lua Visual Studio Code（以下简称 VS Code）是一款由微软推出的免费且开源的代码编辑器。Emmy Lua 是一款专为 Lua 语言开发者设计的插件。本文将介绍如何安装 VS Code 并配置 Emmy Lua 环境，以便进行 Lua 开发。 Visual Studio Code (VS Code for short) is a free and open-source code editor from Microsoft, and Emmy Lua is a plugin designed for Lua developers. This article explains how to install VS Code and configure the Emmy Lua environment so that you can develop in Lua. 安装 VS Code Installing VS Code 首先，我们需要下载并安装 VS Code。请按照以下步骤操作： 访问 VS Code 官网。 点击 “Download for Windows”（如果你使用 Windows 操作系统）或 “Download for Mac”（如果你使用 macOS 操作系统）。 根据你的操作系统选择适合的安装程序，并下载。 运行下载好的安装程序，并按照提示进行安装。 First we need to download and install VS Code. Follow these steps: Visit the VS Code official site. Click “Download for Windows” (if you use Windows) or “Download for Mac” (if you use macOS). Choose the installer that matches your operating system and download it. Run the downloaded installer and follow the prompts to complete the installation. 或者，可以从以下链接进行安装 Alternatively, you can install it from the link below: https://vscode.cdn.azure.cn/stable/3a6960b964327f0e3882ce18fcebd07ed191b316/VSCodeUserSetup-x64-1.62.2.exe 安装 Emmy Lua Installing Emmy Lua 安装 VS Code 后，我们需要安装 Emmy Lua 插件。请按照以下步骤操作： 打开 VS Code。 点击左侧的扩展图标（或按下快捷键 Ctrl + Shift + X）。 在搜索框中输入 “Emmy Lua” 并选择第一个搜索结果。 点击 “Install” 按钮，等待插件安装完成。 After installing VS Code, we need to install the Emmy Lua plugin. Follow these steps: Open VS Code. Click the Extensions icon on the left side (or press Ctrl + Shift + X). Type “Emmy Lua” into the search box and select the first result. Click the “Install” button and wait for the plugin to finish installing. 配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Configuring the Emmy Lua Environment 配置 Emmy Lua 环境需要先安装 JDK。如果你已经安装了 JDK，可以跳过本节内容。 Configuring the Emmy Lua environment requires the JDK to be installed first. If you already have the JDK installed, you can skip this section. 安装 JDK Installing the JDK 推荐 JDK 版本在 "1.8.0_181" 以上。 A JDK version of "1.8.0_181" or newer is recommended. 访问 JDK 下载页面。 选择适合你操作系统的版本，并下载。 运行下载好的安装程序，并按照提示进行安装。 Visit the JDK download page. Choose the version that matches your operating system and download it. Run the downloaded installer and follow the prompts to complete the installation. 更加详细的步骤看此文档 For more detailed steps, see this document: 如何安装 JDK（Java Development Kit） 配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Configuring the Emmy Lua Environment 安装完 JDK 后，如果没有设置 JDK 的环境变量，则我们需要对 Emmy Lua 插件进行一些简单的配置。请按照以下步骤操作： After installing the JDK, if you have not set the JDK environment variable, you need to do a little configuration on the Emmy Lua plugin. Follow these steps: 打开 VS Code。 Open VS Code. 点击左侧的扩展图标（或按下快捷键 Ctrl + Shift + X）。 Click the Extensions icon on the left side (or press Ctrl + Shift + X). 在已安装的插件列表中找到 “Emmy Lua” 插件，并点击右侧的 “Extension Settings” 按钮。 In the list of installed plugins, find the “Emmy Lua” plugin and click the “Extension Settings” button on the right. 在弹出的配置面板中，找到 “Emmy: Java Home” 选项，并填入 JDK 的安装路径。 In the settings panel that opens, find the “Emmy: Java Home” option and fill in the JDK installation path. *"emmylua.java.home": "<你的路径>" 注意，路径需要用 / 分割，而非 * "emmylua.java.home": "<your path>" — note that the path must be separated with / rather than a backslash. - 在 Windows 上，默认安装路径为 **C:/Program Files/Java/jdk{版本号}**。 - On Windows, the default installation path is **C:/Program Files/Java/jdk{version}**. - 在 macOS 上，默认安装路径为 **/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk{版本号}/Contents/Home**。 - On macOS, the default installation path is **/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk{version}/Contents/Home**. 配置完成后，关闭配置面板。 Once the configuration is done, close the settings panel. 至此，我们已经成功安装了 VS Code 和 JDK，并配置了 Emmy Lua 环境，可以开始进行 Lua 开发了。 At this point we have successfully installed VS Code and the JDK and configured the Emmy Lua environment, so you can start enjoying Lua development.

manual/mod/jenkins-setup.html.title: 18.1 Jenkins 安装与配置教程 Jenkins Installation and Configuration | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/jenkins-setup.html.summary: 18.1 Jenkins 安装与配置教程 Jenkins Installation and Configuration 1. 安装 Jenkins：Installing Jenkins Jenkins 是一款开源的自动化构建工具，你需要先安装 Jenkins。你可以从 Jenkins 的官方网站 https://www.jenkins.io/download/ 下载适合你系统的 Jenkins 安装包，并按照安装向导完成安装。安装成功后，你可以在浏览器中输入 http://localhost:8080/ 访问 Jenkins。 Jenkins is an open source automation build tool, and you need to install it first. You can download the Jenkins installer for your system from the Jenkins official website https://www.jenkins.io/download/ and install it by following the setup wizard. After a successful installation you can reach Jenkins by entering http://localhost:8080/ in your browser. 面向小白的详细的安装教程：Step-by-step Installation Guide for Beginners 在你的服务器或本地计算机上打开浏览器，并访问 Jenkins 官方网站：https://www.jenkins.io/download/。 On your server or local computer, open a browser and go to the Jenkins official website. 在 Jenkins 下载页面上，你可以看到针对不同操作系统的 Jenkins 安装包。请选择适合你操作系统的下载链接，例如 Windows 系统可选择 Windows MSI 安装包。 On the Jenkins download page you can see installers for the different operating systems. Pick the download link for your own operating system, for example the Windows MSI installer on Windows. 下载完成后，双击安装包以启动安装向导。根据向导提示，选择安装目录、安装类型等设置。默认情况下，Jenkins 将安装在 C:\Program Files (x86)\Jenkins 目录下。 When the download has finished, double click the installer to open the setup wizard. Follow the prompts to choose the install directory, the install type and other settings. By default Jenkins is installed into C:\Program Files (x86)\Jenkins. 在安装过程中，你需要选择 Jenkins 的运行环境。你可以选择将 Jenkins 安装为 Windows 服务，或作为普通的 Windows 程序运行。在大多数情况下，我们建议将其安装为 Windows 服务，以便在系统重启后自动启动 Jenkins。 During the installation you need to choose how Jenkins runs. You can install Jenkins as a Windows service or run it as an ordinary Windows program. In most cases we recommend installing it as a Windows service, so that Jenkins starts automatically after the system reboots. 安装完成后，Jenkins 将启动并监听默认的 HTTP 端口 8080。你可以在浏览器中输入 http://localhost:8080/ 访问 Jenkins 的 Web 界面。如果你已将 Jenkins 安装为 Windows 服务，它将在后台自动运行，并且你可以在 Windows 服务列表中找到它，以便在需要时手动启动、停止或重启 Jenkins。 After the installation Jenkins starts and listens on the default HTTP port 8080. You can enter http://localhost:8080/ in your browser to open the Jenkins web interface. If you installed Jenkins as a Windows service it runs in the background automatically, and you can find it in the Windows service list to start, stop or restart it manually when needed. 首次启动 Jenkins 时，你需要输入管理员账户的用户名和密码。随后 Jenkins 会要求你选择要安装的插件，你可以选择推荐插件或手动选择所需插件。插件安装需要一些时间，请耐心等待。 The first time Jenkins starts you need to enter the user name and password of the administrator account. Jenkins then asks you to choose which plugins to install; you can take the recommended plugins or select the ones you need manually. Installing the plugins takes a while, so please be patient. 安装完成后，你将看到 Jenkins 的主界面。至此，Jenkins 已成功安装，你可以开始使用它来构建项目。 Once this is done you will see the Jenkins main interface. Jenkins is now installed successfully and you can start using it to build your projects. 2. 安装 Unity3D：Installing Unity3D 在 Jenkins 中打包 Unity3D 项目之前，需要在 Jenkins 服务器上安装 Unity3D。请确保安装了适合你项目的 Unity3D 版本。 Before you can build a Unity3D project in Jenkins, Unity3D has to be installed on the Jenkins server. Make sure the Unity3D version you install is the one your project needs. Unity Engine Requirement Unity 引擎版本要求 3. 安装 Unity3D 插件：Installing the Unity3D Plugin 在 Jenkins 中打包 Unity3D 项目需要安装 Unity3D 插件。打开 Jenkins，进入“插件管理”页面，搜索“Unity3D”并安装。安装成功后，你需要重启 Jenkins。 Building a Unity3D project in Jenkins requires the Unity3D plugin. Open Jenkins, go to the plugin management page, search for "Unity3D" and install it. After a successful installation you need to restart Jenkins. 4. 配置 Jenkins 项目：Configuring the Jenkins Project 进入 Jenkins 项目的“配置”页面，并设置 Unity3D 安装目录路径。 Go to the configuration page of the Jenkins project and set the path of the Unity3D installation directory there. 5. 创建 Jenkins 项目：Creating a Jenkins Project 在 Jenkins 中创建一个新项目。进入 Jenkins 主页，点击“新建项目”按钮，选择“自由风格软件项目”并输入项目名称。 Create a new project in Jenkins. Go to the Jenkins home page, click the new project button, choose the freestyle software project type and enter a project name. 增加一个构建步骤： Add a build step. 选择刚刚配置的 Unity，然后设置如下打包命令： Select the Unity installation you just configured, then set the following build command. -projectPath <项目路径> -batchmode -quit -executeMethod ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest -config <配置文件路径>

manual/mod/lua-api2-air-warning.html.title: 22.7.4 用例：敌机接近告警 Example: Enemy Aircraft Warning | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/lua-api2-air-warning.html.summary: 22.7.4 用例：敌机接近告警 Example: Enemy Aircraft Warning 敌方飞机进入 3 公里内时，播放一次告警音效并打印最近一架的名字；飞机离开后重新开始监视。 When an enemy aircraft comes within 3 km, play an alert sound once and print the name of the nearest one; resume monitoring once the aircraft leaves. 以前常见的写法是每秒取出场景里的所有刚体，再逐个判断是不是飞机、是不是敌人。VehicleAPI.CreateQuery() 在游戏内部完成筛选和排序，Lua 只拿到结果；它的数据来自战场玩家列表，联机时也包含其他玩家。 A common approach in the past was to retrieve all rigid bodies in the scene every second and then check each one to see if it was an aircraft and an enemy. VehicleAPI.CreateQuery() performs the filtering and sorting internally within the game, so Lua only receives the results; its data comes from the battle player list and includes other players during online battles. Behavior() Property = { warnDistance = { type = "number", value = 3000 }, -- 米 / Metres soundGuid = { type = "string", value = "" }, -- 告警音效的 FMOD 事件 guid / FMOD event guid of the warning sound } local AirThreatWarning = class("AirThreatWarning") function AirThreatWarning:OnVehicleReady(vehicle) self.vehicle = vehicle -- 查询对象只建一次，之后反复使用 / Create the query once and reuse it self.query = VehicleAPI.CreateQuery() self.query.Kind = VehicleKind.Flight self.query.Relation = VehicleRelation.Enemy self.query.MaxDistance = self.warnDistance self.query.MaxCount = 1 -- 只要最近的一架 / Only the nearest one self.query.SortByDistance = true self.warned = false self.script:SetUpdateInterval(0.5) end function AirThreatWarning:OnUpdated(dt) if not VehicleAPI.IsLocalPlayer(self.vehicle) then return end local count = self.query:Run(self.vehicle) if count > 0 and not self.warned then self.warned = true local nearest = self.query:Get(0) print(string.format("[AirWarning] %s at %.0f m", VehicleAPI.GetDisplayName(nearest), self.query:GetDistance(0))) if self.soundGuid ~= "" then SoundAPI.PlayOneShot(self.soundGuid, self.transform.position) end elseif count == 0 then self.warned = false end end return AirThreatWarning 查询对象的属性： Properties of the query object: 属性 Property 含义 Meaning Kind VehicleKind.Any / Ground / Flight / Army，单选 Pick one Relation VehicleRelation.Any / Enemy / Friendly，相对于 Run 传入的载具 Relative to the vehicle passed to Run MaxDistance 最大距离（米），0 为不限 Maximum distance in metres, 0 for no limit MaxCount 最多返回几辆，默认 32 At most this many results, 32 by default SortByDistance 按距离从近到远排序，默认开启 Nearest first, on by default 要点： Key points: 查询对象在 OnVehicleReady 里建一次，之后反复调用 Run，不会产生垃圾。 Run(vehicle) 以这辆载具的位置和队伍为准，结果里不包含它自己；地图和模式脚本可以用 RunAt(position, team)。 结果按序号读取：Get(i) 返回载具，GetDistance(i) 返回距离，序号从 0 开始。 联机对战中，只会返回你的队伍当前看得见的敌人。 Create the query object once in OnVehicleReady, then call Run repeatedly; this will not generate garbage. Run(vehicle) uses the position and team of this vehicle as the reference, and the results do not include the vehicle itself; map and mode scripts can use RunAt(position, team). Read the results by index: Get(i) returns the vehicle, GetDistance(i) returns the distance, with indices starting from 0. In online battles, only enemies currently visible to your team are returned.

manual/mod/lua-api2-charged-shot.html.title: 22.7.2 用例：蓄力伤害加成 Example: Charged-Shot Damage Bonus | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/lua-api2-charged-shot.html.summary: 22.7.2 用例：蓄力伤害加成 Example: Charged-Shot Damage Bonus 装填完成后，主炮开始蓄力，伤害加成随时间增长，蓄满后为 +50%；开火后蓄力清零。 Once reloading is complete, the main gun begins to charge. The damage bonus increases over time, reaching +50% at full charge; the charge resets to zero after firing. 以前的写法是每次数值变化都移除旧 buff、再新建一个，每帧都在分配内存。BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff 创建一个数值可变的 buff：挂到属性上一次，之后只调用 SetValue，属性会原地刷新。 The previous approach removed the old buff and created a new one for every numerical change, allocating memory every frame. BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff creates a buff with a mutable value: attach it to a stat once, then only call SetValue, and the stat refreshes in place. Behavior() Property = { maxBonus = { type = "number", value = 0.5 }, -- 蓄满时伤害 +50% / +50% damage when fully charged chargeTime = { type = "number", value = 4 }, -- 蓄满需要的秒数 / Seconds to charge fully } local ChargedShot = class("ChargedShot") function ChargedShot:OnVehicleReady(vehicle) self.weapon = WeaponAPI.GetWeapon(vehicle, 0) if self.weapon == nil then self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(false) return end self.charge = 0 -- 挂一次，之后只改数值 / Attach once, then only change the value self.buff = BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff("Charged Shot", false, 0) self.weapon.DamageBuffedCoff:AddBuff(self.buff) -- 开火后蓄力清零 / Firing resets the charge WeaponAPI.OnFired(self.script, self.weapon, function() self.charge = 0 self.buff:SetValue(0) end) self.script:SetUpdateInterval(0.1) end function ChargedShot:OnUpdated(dt) if not WeaponAPI.IsReloaded(self.weapon) then return end self.charge = math.min(self.charge + dt / self.chargeTime, 1) -- 数值没变时 SetValue 什么也不做 / SetValue does nothing when the value is unchanged self.buff:SetValue(self.charge * self.maxBonus) end function ChargedShot:OnDestroyed() if self.buff ~= nil then self.weapon.DamageBuffedCoff:RemoveBuff(self.buff) end end return ChargedShot 要点： Key points: CreateValueBuff 的第二个参数为 false 时是加法系数，0.5 表示 +50%；为 true 时是乘法系数，会和其他乘法 buff 连乘。 SetValue 在数值没有变化时什么也不做，所以可以放心地在 OnUpdated 里调用。 SetUpdateInterval(0.1) 让 OnUpdated 每秒只调用 10 次，dt 会是对应的间隔，蓄力速度不受帧率影响。 不再需要这个 buff 时，用属性的 RemoveBuff 把它取下。 When the second parameter of CreateValueBuff is false, it is an additive coefficient, where 0.5 means +50%; when true, it is a multiplicative coefficient, which multiplies with other multiplicative buffs. SetValue does nothing if the value has not changed, so it is safe to call within OnUpdated. SetUpdateInterval(0.1) ensures OnUpdated is called only 10 times per second, with dt corresponding to that interval, so the charge rate is unaffected by frame rate. When this buff is no longer needed, take it off with the stat's RemoveBuff.

manual/mod/lua-api2-engine-gear.html.summary:
引擎转速与起落架 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run lua-api2-engine-gear 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "script": "${fixture}/EngineAndGear.lua", "prefab": "${fixture}/Tutorial_EngineAndGear.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(String)" } } ] } 把脚本挂到载具，按需绑定 fan、smoke 或 gearLights。飞机先读取起落架初始状态，再用 FlightAPI.OnGearChanged 更新灯光。事件订阅传入 self.script，并关闭飞机分支的逐帧更新。 地面分支从 TankAPI.GetEngineState 读取成功标记、转速、转速百分比、挡位、速度和倒车状态。每分钟转数乘 6 得到每秒角度，示例额外按 0.1 缩放风扇转速，并在转速百分比超过 80 时显示烟雾。 Behavior() Property = { fan = { type = "object", value = nil }, smoke = { type = "object", value = nil }, gearLights = { type = "object", value = nil }, } local EngineAndGear = class("EngineAndGear") function EngineAndGear:OnVehicleReady(vehicle) self.vehicle = vehicle if self.gearLights:SetActive(isDown) end) end self.vehicle = nil self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(false) return end self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(self.fan ~= nil or self.smoke ~= nil) end function EngineAndGear:OnUpdated(dt) if self.vehicle == nil then return end local ok, rpm, rpmPercent = TankAPI.GetEngineState(self.vehicle) if not ok then return end if self.fan ~= nil then self.fan.transform:Rotate(0, 0, rpm * 6 * dt * 0.1) end if self.smoke ~= nil then self.smoke:SetActive(rpmPercent > 80) end end return EngineAndGear 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", manual/mod/lua-api2-missile-rack.html.title: 22.7.1 用例：导弹挂架随弹药显示 Example: A Missile Rack That Follows the Ammo | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/lua-api2-missile-rack.html.summary: 22.7.1 用例：导弹挂架随弹药显示 Example: A Missile Rack That Follows the Ammo 每发射一枚导弹，挂架上就少一枚模型；补给后模型重新出现。弹药数量由游戏提供，脚本不用自己统计发射次数，也不需要判断是否在车库：车库里弹药是满的，模型自然全部显示。 Each time a missile is fired, one model is removed from the rack; the models reappear after resupply. The ammunition count is provided by the game, so the script does not need to track the number of shots fired itself, nor does it need to check whether the vehicle is in the garage: in the garage, the ammunition is full, so all models are naturally displayed. 把脚本挂在载具模型上，把导弹模型命名为同一个前缀加序号（例如 Missile_1、Missile_2……），在属性里填写武器序号和前缀。 Attach the script to the vehicle model, name the missile models with the same prefix followed by a sequence number (for example Missile_1, Missile_2...), and fill in the weapon index and prefix in the properties. Behavior() Property = { weaponIndex = { type = "number", value = 1 }, -- 第几件武器（0 开始） / Weapon index, from 0 modelPrefix = { type = "string", value = "Missile_" }, } local MissileRack = class("MissileRack") function MissileRack:OnVehicleReady(vehicle) self.weapon = WeaponAPI.GetWeapon(vehicle, self.weaponIndex) if self.weapon == nil then print("[MissileRack] weapon " .. tostring(self.weaponIndex) .. " not found") return end -- 只在这里找一次，按层级顺序；空数组说明模型上没有这些节点 -- Look them up once, in hierarchy order; an empty array means the model has none self.models = TransformAPI.FindAllDeep(self.transform, self.modelPrefix) -- 每发一枚、每次补给都会触发；行为销毁时自动退订 -- Fires on every shot and every resupply; ends with the behaviour WeaponAPI.OnAmmoChanged(self.script, self.weapon, function() self:Refresh() end) self:Refresh() end function MissileRack:Refresh() local left = WeaponAPI.GetTotalAmmo(self.weapon) for i = 0, self.models.Length - 1 do self.models[i].gameObject:SetActive(i < left) end end return MissileRack 要点： Key points: TransformAPI.FindAllDeep 只在 OnVehicleReady 里调用一次。返回的数组按层级顺序排列，所以模型在层级里的顺序就是消耗的顺序。 WeaponAPI.OnAmmoChanged 在每次开火和每次补给时触发；传入 self.script 后，行为销毁时自动退订。 这个脚本没有 OnUpdated，完全由事件驱动，平时没有任何每帧开销。 TransformAPI.FindAllDeep should only be called once in OnVehicleReady. The returned array is arranged in hierarchy order, so the order of the models in the hierarchy is the order in which they are consumed. WeaponAPI.OnAmmoChanged is triggered on every shot and every resupply; passing self.script ensures that the subscription is automatically unsubscribed when the behaviour is destroyed. This script has no OnUpdated, is entirely event-driven, and has no per-frame overhead during normal operation.

manual/mod/lua-api2-overview.html.title: 22.7 Lua API 2 概览 Lua API 2 Overview | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/lua-api2-overview.html.summary: 22.7 Lua API 2 概览 Lua API 2 Overview 从 API 版本 2 起（全局变量 GAME_API_VERSION 为 2），游戏为 Mod 脚本提供了一组新接口：载具装配完成的回调、随行为自动结束的事件订阅，以及战场查询、雷达、武器、载具状态等读取接口。它们直接使用游戏自己的数据和事件，比在脚本里扫描场景、按名字递归查找节点或每帧轮询更快，也更可靠。 From API version 2 onwards (when the global variable GAME_API_VERSION is 2), the game provides a set of new interfaces for Mod scripts: a callback for when vehicle assembly is complete, event subscriptions that end automatically with the behaviour, and read interfaces for querying the battle, radar, weapons, and vehicle status. These interfaces use the game's own data and events directly, making them faster and more reliable than scanning the scene in scripts, recursively finding nodes by name, or polling every frame. 本节的用例 Examples in this section: 22.7.1 用例：导弹挂架随弹药显示 Example: A Missile Rack That Follows the Ammo 22.7.2 用例：蓄力伤害加成 Example: Charged-Shot Damage Bonus 22.7.3 用例：防空雷达屏幕 Example: Air-Defence Radar Screen 22.7.4 用例：敌机接近告警 Example: Enemy Aircraft Warning 22.7.5 用例：模块被毁时播放动画 Example: Animation When a Module Is Destroyed 22.7.6 用例：引擎转速与起落架 Example: Engine RPM and Landing Gear 判断客户端版本 Checking the Client Version 老版本的客户端没有这些接口，GAME_API_VERSION 为 nil。你的 Mod 需要兼容老客户端时，先判断版本： Older versions of the client do not have these interfaces; GAME_API_VERSION is nil. When your Mod needs to be compatible with older clients, check the version first: Behavior() Property = {} local MyBehavior = class("MyBehavior") function MyBehavior:OnStarted() -- 老客户端没有 API 2：GAME_API_VERSION 为 nil / Older clients have no API 2: GAME_API_VERSION is nil if (GAME_API_VERSION or 1) < 2 then print("[MyBehavior] this mod needs a newer game client") return end end function MyBehavior:OnVehicleReady(vehicle) -- 所属载具装配完成后调用一次；车库里也会调用 -- Called once when the vehicle is assembled, in the garage too self.vehicle = vehicle if VehicleAPI.IsGarage(vehicle) then -- 车库里不需要战斗逻辑 / No battle logic in the garage self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(false) return end -- 每 0.2 秒调用一次 OnUpdated / Call OnUpdated every 0.2 s self.script:SetUpdateInterval(0.2) end function MyBehavior:OnUpdated(dt) -- dt：距上次调用的秒数 / dt: seconds since the previous call end function MyBehavior:OnVehicleDestroyed(vehicle) -- 所属载具被击毁 / The vehicle was destroyed end function MyBehavior:OnDestroyed() -- 用 self.script 订阅的事件随后自动退订，不用手动注销 -- Subscriptions made with self.script end right after this; nothing to unregister end return MyBehavior 行为回调 Behaviour Callbacks 回调 Callback 何时调用 When it runs OnStarted() 脚本运行后立即调用。挂在载具上时，载具可能还没装配完。 Right after the script runs. On a vehicle, the vehicle may not be assembled yet. OnVehicleReady(vehicle) 所属载具装配完成后调用一次；脚本运行时载具已经装好的话，紧接在 OnStarted 之后调用。车库里也会调用。不在载具上的行为（地图、特效）不会收到。 Once, when the owning vehicle is assembled; right after OnStarted if it already is. Also in the garage. Behaviours not on a vehicle (maps, effects) never get it. OnUpdated(dt) 每帧调用，或按 SetUpdateInterval 的间隔调用；dt 是距上次调用的秒数。 Every frame, or at the interval set with SetUpdateInterval; dt is the time since the previous call. OnVehicleDestroyed(vehicle) 所属载具被击毁时。 When the owning vehicle is destroyed. OnDestroyed() 行为销毁时。之后本行为的事件订阅全部自动结束。 When the behaviour is destroyed. Its event subscriptions all end right after. 挂在载具数据上的行为（载具、炮塔、武器的 Lua 行为），在 OnStarted 里就能读到游戏传入的属性：坦克的这些行为都有 self.vehicle，炮塔上的行为有 self.turretController，坦克武器上的有 self.tankFire，飞机武器上的有 self.flightFire。任何行为都可以用 self.script:GetVehicle() 取得所属载具。 Behaviours attached to vehicle data (Lua behaviours for vehicles, turrets, and weapons) can read the properties passed by the game in OnStarted: these behaviours on tanks all have self.vehicle, behaviours on turrets have self.turretController, those on tank weapons have self.tankFire, and those on aircraft weapons have self.flightFire. Any behaviour can obtain its parent vehicle using self.script:GetVehicle(). self.script 方法 Method 作用 Purpose self.script:GetVehicle() 所属载具（坦克、飞机、步兵都适用），不在载具上时为 nil。结果会缓存，可以每帧调用。 The owning vehicle (tank, aircraft or infantry), or nil. Cached, so it is fine every frame. self.script:SetUpdateInterval(seconds) OnUpdated 的调用间隔，0 为每帧。间隔内的帧不会调用 Lua。 How often OnUpdated runs; 0 means every frame. Frames in between do not call Lua. self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(false) 完全停止调用 OnUpdated；事件回调和 OnGUI 不受影响。传 true 恢复。 Stops calling OnUpdated; event callbacks and OnGUI keep working. Pass true to resume. 事件订阅 Event Subscriptions 所有新事件的写法相同：XxxAPI.OnSomething(self.script, target, callback)，依次传入 self.script、目标和回调，返回一个订阅对象。 All new events follow the same syntax: XxxAPI.OnSomething(self.script, target, callback), passing self.script, the target, and the callback in order, which returns a subscription object. local sub = WeaponAPI.OnAmmoChanged(self.script, weapon, function() self:Refresh() end) -- 想提前停止时 / To stop earlier: -- sub:Dispose() 传入 self.script 的订阅在行为销毁时自动结束，不用在 OnDestroyed 里手动注销。 目标载具被移除时，订阅也会自动结束。 游戏模式脚本和依赖库没有 self.script，可以传 nil；这样的订阅在退出游戏模式时自动结束。 sub.IsActive 表示订阅是否仍然有效。 回调连续出错 10 次后会被停用，日志里会写明是哪个脚本。 Subscriptions made with self.script end automatically when the behaviour is destroyed; you do not need to manually unregister them in OnDestroyed. Subscriptions also automatically end when the target vehicle is removed. Game mode scripts and dependency libraries do not have self.script; you can pass nil. Such subscriptions automatically end when the game mode is exited. sub.IsActive indicates whether the subscription is still valid. If a callback errors out 10 times consecutively, it will be disabled, and the log will specify which script caused it. 接口一览 API at a Glance 类 Class 用途 Purpose 常用函数 Common functions VehicleAPI 载具身份与状态、战场查询、全场事件 Vehicle identity and state, battle queries, battle-wide events GetContext IsGarage IsLocalPlayer IsBot IsRemote IsAlive GetTeam IsEnemy GetDisplayName GetGuid GetVelocity GetSpeedKmh GetAimPoint CreateQuery OnVehicleSpawned OnVehicleKilled RadarAPI 读取游戏的雷达（地面防空与机载） The game's radars (ground air defence and airborne) TryGetRadar IsActive GetWorkMode GetScanAzimuth GetContactCount GetContact GetContactWorldAzimuth GetLockedTarget TryLock Unlock OnLockChanged OnThreat WeaponAPI 武器：弹药、装填、开火与命中事件、提前量 Weapons: ammo, reload, fire and hit events, lead GetWeaponCount GetWeapon GetAmmo GetTotalAmmo IsReloaded GetReloadProgress GetReloadTime GetMuzzle GetShellSpeed PredictLead OnFired OnAmmoChanged OnReloaded OnHit OnKill TankAPI 炮塔节点、引擎状态 Turret nodes, engine state GetTurretCount GetTurretTransform GetGunTransform GetEngineState FlightAPI 飞行状态、起落架 Flight state, landing gear IsOnGround IsGearDown GetAirspeedKmh GetAltitude GetThrottle IsEngineRunning OnGearChanged InternalModuleAPI 内部模块的状态与事件 Internal module state and events GetInternalModule IsDestroyed GetHitPointRatio OnStateChanged OnDamaged OnRepaired CameraAPI 玩家相机 The player's camera GetCameraMode IsZoomed GetLockTarget TransformAPI 按名字查找节点 Find nodes by name FindDeep FindAllDeep BuffAPI 数值可变的 buff Buffs whose value changes CreateValueBuff TimeAPI 是否暂停 Pause state IsPaused 每个函数的参数与说明见 API 文档里的 ShanghaiWindy.Core.API 命名空间；在 VS Code 里配置好 EmmyLua 后，编辑时也会显示提示。 See the ShanghaiWindy.Core.API namespace in the API documentation for the parameters and descriptions of each function; after configuring EmmyLua in VS Code, hints will also be displayed while editing. 约定 Conventions 传入 nil、已销毁的对象或越界的序号时，接口返回 false、0 或 nil，不会报错，不需要再用 pcall 包住每一行。 读取类接口每次调用都不产生垃圾。会分配内存的只有 CreateQuery、FindAllDeep 这类初始化接口，请只在初始化时调用一次。 联机对战中，读取其他载具的接口只返回你的队伍当前看得见的敌人；雷达目标本身已经经过探测判定。 控制类接口（例如雷达锁定）只对玩家正在控制的载具生效，对其他载具返回 false。 When passing nil, a destroyed object, or an out-of-bounds index, the interfaces return false, 0, or nil without throwing an error, so you do not need to wrap every line in pcall. Read interfaces do not generate garbage on every call. Only initialisation interfaces like CreateQuery and FindAllDeep allocate memory; please call them only once during initialisation. In online battles, interfaces that read other vehicles only return enemies currently visible to your team; radar targets have already undergone detection checks. Control interfaces (such as radar lock) only work on the vehicle currently controlled by the player and return false for other vehicles. 性能建议 Performance Tips 下面这些是 Lua 审核里最常见的性能问题和对应的写法： These are the most common performance problems found by the Lua audit, and what to do instead: 不要每帧扫描整个场景（GetObjectsInWorld、FindObjectsOfType）来找载具，用 VehicleAPI.CreateQuery()。 不要每帧递归查找节点。在 OnVehicleReady 里用 TransformAPI.FindDeep 找一次；找不到就说明模型上没有，不要重试。 不要在 OnUpdated 里反复重试初始化，把初始化放进 OnVehicleReady。 不需要每帧执行的逻辑，用 SetUpdateInterval 降低频率；完全靠事件驱动的脚本，用 SetUpdateEnabled(false) 关掉 OnUpdated。 弹药、装填、模块、起落架、雷达锁定这些状态变化都有事件，不要轮询。 Do not scan the entire scene every frame (GetObjectsInWorld, FindObjectsOfType) to find vehicles; use VehicleAPI.CreateQuery(). Do not recursively find nodes every frame. Use TransformAPI.FindDeep once in OnVehicleReady; if it is not found, it means it is not on the model, so do not retry. Do not repeatedly retry initialisation in OnUpdated; put initialisation in OnVehicleReady. For logic that does not need to run every frame, use SetUpdateInterval to lower the frequency; for scripts that are entirely event-driven, use SetUpdateEnabled(false) to turn off OnUpdated. Ammo, reload, module, landing gear and radar lock changes all have events; do not poll them. 从旧写法迁移 Migrating from Old Workarounds 旧写法 Old workaround 改用 Use instead 每秒 GetObjectsInWorld("Rigidbody") 找飞机，或读 Identity.GlobalTeamList GetObjectsInWorld("Rigidbody") every second, or reading Identity.GlobalTeamList VehicleAPI.CreateQuery()；雷达车直接用 RadarAPI（GlobalTeamList 在联机时不含远程玩家） VehicleAPI.CreateQuery(); radar vehicles use RadarAPI (GlobalTeamList has no remote players online) 向下 RaycastAll 判断地杂波、自己限制仰角 Casting RaycastAll down for ground clutter, clamping elevation yourself 在载具数据的 groundAARadarData 里配置雷达，读 RadarAPI.GetContact Configure the radar in groundAARadarData, read RadarAPI.GetContact 把 InstanceNetType 转成字符串比较、读 GarageManager.inGarage、和 GetPlayerVehicle() 比较 Comparing InstanceNetType as text, reading GarageManager.inGarage, comparing with GetPlayerVehicle() VehicleAPI.IsGarage / IsLocalPlayer / IsBot / IsRemote Time.timeScale < 0.01 TimeAPI.IsPaused() 在 OnUpdated 里反复 TryGetTankInitSystem、重试初始化 Calling TryGetTankInitSystem or retrying init in OnUpdated OnVehicleReady(vehicle) 递归 GetChild 查找 TurretTransform / GunTransform / FFPoint Walking GetChild for TurretTransform / GunTransform / FFPoint TankAPI.GetTurretTransform / GetGunTransform，WeaponAPI.GetMuzzle 读 bulletCountList、simpleReloadNowTime，反射私有字段 Reading bulletCountList, simpleReloadNowTime, reflecting private fields WeaponAPI.GetAmmo / GetReloadProgress / GetReloadTime 自己统计发射次数 Counting shots yourself WeaponAPI.OnAmmoChanged + GetTotalAmmo 每帧猜测模块血量的字段名 Guessing module hit point field names every frame InternalModuleAPI.OnStateChanged 挨个尝试 "curRPM"、"engineRPM" 等字段 Trying "curRPM", "engineRPM" and similar fields TankAPI.GetEngineState 遍历 WheelCollider.isGrounded，按节点名判断起落架 Walking WheelCollider.isGrounded, telling the gear state from node names FlightAPI.IsOnGround / IsGearDown / OnGearChanged 自己写带阻力的提前量解算 Writing your own drag-aware lead solver WeaponAPI.PredictLead 每帧 RemoveBuff 再新建 buff RemoveBuff and a new buff every frame BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff + SetValue 帧回调 + Time.frameCount 去重 A frame tick plus Time.frameCount de-duplication SetUpdateInterval，使用 OnUpdated(dt)

manual/mod/lua-api2-radar-screen.html.title: 22.7.3 用例：防空雷达屏幕 Example: Air-Defence Radar Screen | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/lua-api2-radar-screen.html.summary: 22.7.3 用例：防空雷达屏幕 Example: Air-Defence Radar Screen 游戏自带完整的雷达系统：按雷达方程探测、地杂波、地形遮挡、锁定捕获时间、给目标的雷达告警，以及游戏自己的雷达界面。你只需要在载具数据里配置 groundAARadarData，雷达就会工作；脚本负责的只是你自己设计的那块屏幕。 The game includes a complete radar system: detection via the radar equation, ground clutter, terrain occlusion, lock-on capture time, radar warnings to the target, and the game's own radar interface. You only need to configure groundAARadarData in the vehicle data for the radar to work; the script is only responsible for the screen you design yourself. 配置雷达 Configuring the Radar 在载具数据（VehicleTextData）的 groundAARadarData 里勾选 hasRadar，常用的字段： In the vehicle data (VehicleTextData), tick hasRadar within groundAARadarData. Commonly used fields: 字段 Field 含义 Meaning maxDetectionRange 最大探测距离（米） Maximum detection range (m) isFullRotation / fullRotationRate 360° 旋转搜索及其转速（度/秒） 360° rotating search and its rate (°/s) searchAzimuthHalfAngle / searchElevationHalfAngle 搜索区的水平与俯仰半角 Half angles of the search area minElevationAngle 低于这个俯仰角的目标按地杂波过滤 Targets below this elevation are filtered as ground clutter detectGroundTargets 打开后不做地杂波过滤，可以探测地面载具（战场搜索雷达） Skips the clutter filter so ground vehicles are detected (battlefield search radar) displayRanges 屏幕可切换的量程 Display ranges you can switch between canUsePD / pdMinDetectableSpeed 脉冲多普勒模式及最低可探测速度 Pulse-Doppler mode and its minimum detectable speed hasIFF 敌我识别；没有时无法区分友军 IFF; without it friendly contacts cannot be told apart 屏幕脚本 The Screen Script Behavior() Property = {} local RadarScreen = class("RadarScreen") local GUI = CS.UnityEngine.GUI local Rect = CS.UnityEngine.Rect function RadarScreen:OnVehicleReady(vehicle) -- 雷达参数在载具数据的 groundAARadarData 里配置，这里只读结果 -- The radar is configured in the vehicle data (groundAARadarData); the script only reads it local ok, radar = RadarAPI.TryGetRadar(vehicle) if not ok then self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(false) return end self.vehicle = vehicle self.radar = radar self.text = "" RadarAPI.OnLockChanged(self.script, radar, function(locked, target) if locked then print("[Radar] locked " .. VehicleAPI.GetDisplayName(target)) else print("[Radar] lock lost") end end) -- 每秒刷新 5 次列表就够了 / Five list refreshes a second are enough self.script:SetUpdateInterval(0.2) end function RadarScreen:OnUpdated(dt) -- 玩家可能在编组的载具之间切换，所以每次刷新时判断，而不是在 OnVehicleReady 里关掉 -- The player may switch between the vehicles of a group, so check on every refresh instead of turning updates off once self.visible = VehicleAPI.IsLocalPlayer(self.vehicle) and RadarAPI.IsActive(self.radar) if not self.visible then return end local lines = {} local count = RadarAPI.GetContactCount(self.radar) for i = 0, count - 1 do local ok, target, distance, azimuth, elevation, altitude, radialSpeed, isFriendly = RadarAPI.GetContact(self.radar, i) if ok then local name = target ~= nil and VehicleAPI.GetDisplayName(target) or "?" local bearing = RadarAPI.GetContactWorldAzimuth(self.radar, i) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s %s %.1f km %03.0f° %.0f m", isFriendly and "+" or "!", name, distance / 1000, bearing, altitude) end end self.text = table.concat(lines, "\n") end function RadarScreen:OnGUI() if self.visible then -- 只画缓存好的文字，不在 OnGUI 里计算 / Draw the cached text only; compute nothing in OnGUI GUI.Label(Rect(20, 120, 360, 300), self.text) end end return RadarScreen 要点： Key points: 目标列表用 GetContactCount 和 GetContact 读取。GetContact 一次返回多个值：是否成功、目标载具、距离、方位、俯仰、高度、径向速度、是否友军。目标是箔条回波时，目标载具为 nil。 GetContact 给出的方位和俯仰是雷达自身坐标系下的角度（度）。画北向朝上的屏幕时，用 GetContactWorldAzimuth 取世界方位。 想让模型上的天线跟着转，可以读 RadarAPI.GetScanAzimuth：它是天线相对安装座的偏航角，范围 -180 到 180 度。 列表每秒刷新 5 次，OnGUI 只画缓存好的文字。不要在 OnGUI 里计算，它一帧会被调用好几次。 远程玩家的载具副本不会在本地运行雷达，读到的目标数为 0；联机时读取敌方载具的雷达也返回 0。 RadarAPI.TryLock、Unlock、CycleTarget、SwitchMode 只对玩家正在控制的载具生效。TryLock 和玩家按键锁定一样：目标必须在雷达屏幕上，并且有捕获时间。 The target list is read using GetContactCount and GetContact. GetContact returns multiple values at once: success status, target vehicle, distance, azimuth, elevation, altitude, radial velocity, and whether it is a friendly unit. If the target is a chaff echo, the target vehicle is nil. The azimuth and elevation provided by GetContact are angles (in degrees) in the radar's own coordinate system. When drawing a screen with north at the top, use GetContactWorldAzimuth to get the world azimuth. If you want the antenna on the model to rotate accordingly, you can read RadarAPI.GetScanAzimuth: it is the yaw angle of the antenna relative to its mount, ranging from -180 to 180 degrees. The list refreshes 5 times per second, and OnGUI only draws cached text. Do not perform calculations in OnGUI, as it is called multiple times per frame. Vehicle replicas for remote players do not run the radar locally, so the number of targets read will be 0; in online battles, reading the radar of enemy vehicles also returns 0. RadarAPI.TryLock, Unlock, CycleTarget, and SwitchMode only work on the vehicle currently controlled by the player. TryLock works like the player's lock key: the target must be on the radar scope, and the lock takes the acquisition time.

manual/mod/lua-custom-buff.html.summary: 22.5.5 自定义 Lua Buff --- 添加 Buff 测试 local TestAddBuff = class("TestAddBuff") Common() -- 定义装填 Buff local ReloadBuff = class("ReloadBuff") function ReloadBuff:GetBuffDisplayName() return "Lua 减少装填时间 Buff" end function ReloadBuff:ctor() self.IsMultipleCoff = false self.IsZeroBuff = false self.CoffValue = -0.5 self.ConstValue = 0 end function ReloadBuff:ApplyBuff(receiver) local ret, tank = BuffAPI.TryGetBuffReceiverAsTank(receiver) if ret then tank.vehicleComponents.mainTankFire.ReloadSpeedBuffedCoff:AddBuff(self._buffCaster) end print("add buff") end function ReloadBuff:RemoveBuff(receiver, isInterrupt) local ret, tank = BuffAPI.TryGetBuffReceiverAsTank(receiver) if ret then tank.vehicleComponents.mainTankFire.ReloadSpeedBuffedCoff:RemoveBuff(self._buffCaster) end print("remove buff") end function TestAddBuff:OnStarted() -- 将 Lua table 转为 C# 对象 local buffCaster = ConvertAPI.CovertToBuffCaster(ReloadBuff.new()) InputAPI.RegisterKeyInput("add buff", "F1", function() BuffAPI.AddBuff(VehicleAPI.GetPlayerVehicle(), buffCaster) end, function() end) InputAPI.RegisterKeyInput("remove buff", "F2", function() BuffAPI.RemoveBuff(VehicleAPI.GetPlayerVehicle(), buffCaster) end, function() end) end return TestAddBuff 数值会变化的 Buff Buffs Whose Value Changes 如果 buff 的数值需要随时间变化（例如蓄力），不要每次都移除旧 buff 再新建一个。客户端 API 2 起，可以用 BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff 创建一个数值可变的 buff：挂上一次，之后只调用 SetValue，属性会原地刷新。 If a buff's value needs to change over time (for example, charge), do not remove the old buff and create a new one every time. From client API 2 on, you can use BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff to create a buff with a variable value: attach it once, then only call SetValue, and the stat will refresh in place. -- false：加法系数 / false: additive coefficient local buff = BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff("Charged Shot", false, 0) weapon.DamageBuffedCoff:AddBuff(buff) buff:SetValue(0.3) -- 伤害 +30% / +30% damage -- 不再需要时取下 / Take it off when done weapon.DamageBuffedCoff:RemoveBuff(buff) 完整用例见 22.7.2 用例：蓄力伤害加成。 See 22.7.2 Example: Charged shot damage bonus for a complete use case.

manual/mod/lua-random-meteors.html.title: 22.5.4 场景功能：随机陨石 Scene Feature: Random Meteors | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/lua-random-meteors.html.summary: 22.5.4 场景功能：随机陨石 Scene Feature: Random Meteors 编写如下脚本，将其保存为 RandomSpawn.lua，并放置在工程目录下。 Write the following script, save it as RandomSpawn.lua, and place it in the project directory. Behavior() Property = { prefab = { type = "object", value = nil } } local RandomSpawn = class("RandomSpawn") local GameObject = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject local PerlinNoise = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.PerlinNoise local Instantiate = CS.UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3 local meteorAmount = 100 -- 生成的陨石数量 local fieldSize = 100 -- 生成陨石的场景大小 local noiseScale = 10 -- 噪点大小，调整以获得不同的效果 function RandomSpawn:OnStarted() for i = 1, meteorAmount do local x = math.random() * fieldSize local z = math.random() * fieldSize local y = PerlinNoise(x / noiseScale, z / noiseScale) * fieldSize local pos = Vector3(x, y, z) local newMeteor = Instantiate(self.prefab, pos, Quaternion.identity) newMeteor.name = "Meteor_" .. tostring(i) end end return RandomSpawn 为场景物体挂载 LuaBehaviorMono，在行为脚本中选择刚刚编写的 Lua 脚本，然后在 Lua 引用属性中关联该场景物体。 Attach LuaBehaviorMono to a scene object, choose the Lua script you just wrote as its behavior script, then link the scene object in the Lua reference property. 场景内随机生成了一系列陨石。 A series of meteors are randomly spawned in the scene.

manual/mod/map-wizard-tutorial.html.summary: 03. Map Wizard Tutorial 地图教程 The Map Wizard Tool is built for creating custom maps easily. 地图创建指引工具可快速用于地图文件的创建，让你专注于地图的创建，而无需关心相关配置信息的生成。 Create Map 创建地图 Open the tool 打开工具 You can open this tool from this menu if you have installed the Panzer War ToolKit correctly. 你可以在顶部菜单栏打开地图工具。 Create the map 创建地图 Change the map name and click Create New Map. (You can keep the default map name) 修改地图名称，点击按钮 Create New Map。 Modify Map 修改地图 Spawn Points & Way Points 出生点与寻路点 Then, the new map is created. It is an almost empty map. You can add buildings and terrains into it. And you have to set the tag of the buildings and terrains. You can refer to the default objects. Also, you can add points to the map. Finally, you should click re-build path if you changed something on the map. 随后，你的新地图已创建。这是一张几乎为空的地图。你可以向场景中添加建筑与地形，并必须设置这些建筑与地形的标签。你可以参考默认物体。此外，你可以向地图上添加出生点和寻路点。最后，如果你修改了地图内容，需要点击 Re-Build Path 按钮。 Map Info 地图信息配置 Change Render Pipline Type to URP in the MapData. 将地图信息配置的 Render Pipline Type 改成 URP。 Change the supported modes for this map. 修改你希望此地图支持的模式。 Add map name for client display. 为地图增加客户端显示的名称。 Package 打包 Build the assets 编译资源 You can find the BuildPipline file in the folder "ModManager". It names BuildPipline-Map-YourMapName. And click Build Linked Objects to AssetBundle. 你可以在 ModManager 文件夹寻找到地图对应的 BuildPipline 文件夹。点击 Build Linked Objects to AssetBundle 按钮打包资源。 Package Files 打包文件 You can find the ModPackage file in the folder "ModManager". It names Map-YourMapName. Click Package Mod Now. And you can get the .modpack file. 你可以在 ModManager 文件夹寻找到地图对应的 ModPackage 文件夹。点击 Package Mod Now 按钮打包资源。 Extra - Point function 额外 - 功能点 You can add repair and supply point in the map. 通过增加组件和碰撞触发器方式，可以增加补给和维修功能点。

manual/mod/map-workshop-asset-build.html.summary: 20. 地图工坊素材构建 Map Workshop Asset Build 1. 暂时只支持 URP Currently URP Only 建议新建一个模组工程，然后打开 Package Manager 安装 Universal RP。 It is recommended to create a new Mod project, then open the Package Manager and install Universal RP. 2. 素材准备 Asset Preparation 将模型拖入场景，设置坐标为 0, 0, 0，旋转为 0, 0, 0。 Drag the model into the scene, then set its position to 0, 0, 0 and its rotation to 0, 0, 0. 添加碰撞体（Box Collider / Mesh Collider）。 Add a collider (Box Collider / Mesh Collider). 将模型的图层全部设置为 Building（在父物体上设置图层时，可勾选选项以应用于所有子物体）。 Set the layer of the whole model to Building. (When you set the layer on the parent object, a dialog lets you apply it to all child objects as well.) 将此模型拖回 Project 窗口，使其变为 Prefab（预制体）。 Drag the model back into the Project window and it becomes a prefab. 3. 创建数据文件 Create the Data Asset 在已创建的 Prefab 上右键，选择 PropFromSelection，并选择保存路径（请选择项目内的路径）。 Right click the prefab you just created and choose PropFromSelection, then pick a save path (the path must be inside the project). 找到创建出的数据文件，将渲染类型修改为 URP，然后点击更新预制体与更新缩略图。 Open the generated data asset, change the render type to URP, then click update prefab and update thumbnail. 4. 打包 Build 创建 DIYMapDataBuildAssemble，点击自动设置所有打包，将创建的 DIYMapDataBuildAssemble 添加到 ModBuildPipline 中，即可正常打包。同时，可以将重复的资源加入到 LinkedObject，勾选加载依赖资源、共享相同材质球、共享相同模型，以减小模组包体大小。 Create a DIYMapDataBuildAssemble and click the button that sets up all build entries automatically, then add the DIYMapDataBuildAssemble to the ModBuildPipline. It can then be built as usual. You can also add duplicated assets to LinkedObject and enable load dependent assets, share identical materials and share identical models, which reduces the size of the mod package.

manual/mod/mod-mirror-site-setup.html.title: 41. Mod Mirror Site Setup Guide 模组镜像站点搭建指南 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/mod-mirror-site-setup.html.summary: 41. Mod Mirror Site Setup Guide 模组镜像站点搭建指南 Source 源 We have compiled all the Mods, their update dates, and download links in the following JSON file: We will refresh this JSON file every 12 hours. https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json 我们将所有的模组、更新日期及其下载链接整理在如下 JSON 文件中。 我们会每 12 小时刷新一次该 JSON 文件。 https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json Run script 一键下载脚本 We have thoughtfully prepared a Python script for you that allows one-click downloading of all Mods. You can use it directly. 我们贴心地为你准备了一键下载所有模组的 Python 脚本，你可以直接使用。 Dependence 脚本依赖 Before running the script, please ensure that the following dependencies are installed in your Python environment: 在运行脚本之前，请确保你的 Python 环境中已安装以下依赖项： requests: for handling HTTP requests. 用于处理 HTTP 请求。 tqdm: for displaying progress bars. 用于显示进度条。 You can install the dependencies using the following command: 你可以通过以下命令安装依赖： pip install requests tqdm Run Script 运行脚本 import os import json import requests import zipfile import re from datetime import datetime from tqdm import tqdm # Path to the JSON file that tracks downloaded files TRACKING_FILE = 'downloaded_files.json' TEMP_DIR = 'tmp' # Temporary directory for incomplete downloads SAVE_DIR = 'packages' # Base directory where all files will be saved PLATFORM_FOLDERS = { 'PlatformAndroid': 'android', 'PlatformWin64': 'win64', 'PlatformIos': 'ios' } def load_downloaded_files(): """Load the list of downloaded files from the tracking JSON file.""" if os.path.exists(TRACKING_FILE): with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'r') as file: return json.load(file) return {} def save_downloaded_file(downloaded_files, url, local_path): """Save the downloaded file information to the tracking JSON file.""" downloaded_files[url] = local_path with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'w') as file: json.dump(downloaded_files, file, indent=4) def sanitize_mod_name(mod_name): # Remove only special characters that are not allowed in file names return re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*]', '', mod_name) def download_file(url, temp_path): try: response = requests.get(url, stream=True) response.raise_for_status() total_size = int(response.headers.get('content-length', 0)) block_size = 8192 # 8KB progress_bar = tqdm(total=total_size, unit='iB', unit_scale=True, desc=os.path.basename(temp_path), leave=False) with open(temp_path, 'wb') as file: for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=block_size): progress_bar.update(len(chunk)) file.write(chunk) progress_bar.close() if total_size != 0 and progress_bar.n != total_size: print(f"Warning: Downloaded file size mismatch for {temp_path}") else: print(f"Downloaded: {temp_path}") except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f"Failed to download {url}: {e}") def extract_mod_name_from_zip(zip_path): if os.path.exists(zip_path): # Check if the file exists before attempting to open it with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref: if 'package.json' in zip_ref.namelist(): with zip_ref.open('package.json') as package_file: package_data = json.load(package_file) # Check for defaultName in localizedModName mod_name = package_data.get('modName', 'default') localized_mod_name = package_data.get('localizedModName', {}) default_name = localized_mod_name.get('defaultName', '').strip() # Prioritize defaultName if it exists and is not empty if default_name: mod_name = default_name return sanitize_mod_name(mod_name) return None def validate_downloaded_files(downloaded_files): """Check if the files recorded in the tracking JSON exist locally, and remove any entries that don't.""" missing_files = [] for url, path in list(downloaded_files.items()): if not os.path.exists(path): print(f"File missing: {path}. Removing from tracking.") missing_files.append(url) for url in missing_files: del downloaded_files[url] # Save the updated tracking list if missing_files: with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'w') as file: json.dump(downloaded_files, file, indent=4) def download_files_from_json(json_data, downloaded_files): if not os.path.exists(TEMP_DIR): os.makedirs(TEMP_DIR) if not os.path.exists(SAVE_DIR): os.makedirs(SAVE_DIR) with tqdm(total=len(json_data), desc="Overall Progress", unit="file") as overall_progress: for file_info in json_data: file_name = file_info['file_name'] download_link = file_info['download_link'] # Skip if the file is already recorded as downloaded if download_link in downloaded_files: if os.path.exists(downloaded_files[download_link]): print(f"File already downloaded, skipping: {downloaded_files[download_link]}") overall_progress.update(1) continue else: print(f"File {downloaded_files[download_link]} is missing. Redownloading.") del downloaded_files[download_link] # Define the temporary download path temp_file_path = os.path.join(TEMP_DIR, file_name) # Download the file to the temporary location download_file(download_link, temp_file_path) # Extract modName and rename the file with the prefix mod_name = extract_mod_name_from_zip(temp_file_path) if mod_name: new_file_name = f"{mod_name}-#-#-{file_name}" else: new_file_name = file_name # Determine the platform folder based on the filename for platform, folder in PLATFORM_FOLDERS.items(): if platform in file_name: final_dir = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, folder) break else: final_dir = SAVE_DIR # Default to base save directory if no platform is found if not os.path.exists(final_dir): os.makedirs(final_dir) final_file_path = os.path.join(final_dir, new_file_name) # Move the file from the temporary location to the final directory os.rename(temp_file_path, final_file_path) print(f"Moved to: {final_file_path}") # Update the tracking dictionary save_downloaded_file(downloaded_files, download_link, final_file_path) overall_progress.update(1) if __name__ == "__main__": json_url = 'https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json' try: response = requests.get(json_url) response.raise_for_status() json_data = response.json() except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f"Failed to retrieve JSON file from {json_url}: {e}") json_data = [] if json_data: downloaded_files = load_downloaded_files() validate_downloaded_files(downloaded_files) # Ensure the tracked files exist download_files_from_json(json_data, downloaded_files) File synchronization to NetDisk 文件同步至网盘 Using UC NetDisk as an example, automatically back up the packages folder and wait for the synchronization to complete. Once the synchronization is finished, share this folder with the players. This completes the setup of the NetDisk mirror site. 以 UC 网盘为例，自动备份 packages 文件夹，并等待同步完成。同步结束后，将此文件夹共享给玩家，即完成网盘镜像站的搭建。 Alternative Mirror Site Setup Solutions 其他镜像站搭建方案 You can use tools like Nginx to set up a dedicated Mod download site. This helps to offload the traffic from the official downloader and improves download speeds. 可使用 Nginx 等工具搭建专属的模组下载站点，以分流官方下载器的流量压力，并提高下载速度。

Penetration Vs Angle Coff 模块与多炮塔的绑定改为使用配件 GUID。在 VehicleTextData 上，会根据多炮塔数据自动生成一系列 GUID；在模块上填写对应的 GUID，内部模块的 debuff 便会自动与对应炮塔关联 中的多年代改为数组，只需点击一次 VehicleInfo 数据，旧数据便会迁移到新的数组中 2023.6.24 增加飞机 Fmod 工程 2023.4.19 (1.0.10) 修复炮塔带缩放情况下，FFPoint 等节点出现位置偏差的问题 修复 Lua 断点无法识别文件名的问题；需选中已导入 Unity 的 lua 脚本，然后右键 Reimport 2023.4.17 (1.0.8) 修复了 Lua Property 字段在部分情况下解析异常的问题 修复了 Common 类型 Lua 脚本 OnStarted 未调用的问题 增加了一个 Common 类型 Lua 脚本 FollowCameraTutorial，用于轮播局内载具；在战斗中按 F1 生效 2023.4.16 (1.0.7) 修复了编辑器布局错误。 增加了校验工具，用于检查项目中是否存在损坏的资源。 目前支持检测：载具 LOD 是否丢失，VehicleHitBox 是否丢失。 修复了重新打开编辑器后 Vehicle Data Editor 出现的若干问题。 2023.4.15 (1.0.5) 修复了位于 Turret 下的副炮在打包时报错的问题；此 Bug 仅存在于周二及之后版本的编辑器工具中。 2023.4.14 (1.0.4) 增加了飞机仅在瞄准目标后才允许开火的选项。 2023.4.12 新增 Fmod 音效调试工具。 FMOD 音效调试工具 飞机炮塔增加了默认使用父物体纠正轴向的选项。 2023.4.9 试车场增加了对 FPS 武器的支持。 试车场增加了障碍物。 增加了 Lua Profiler，用于监控用户编写的 Lua 脚本性能。请注意耗时超过 0.1 ms 且每帧调用的脚本。 Lua 性能监控 2023.4.6 打包付费模组时，强制检查是否已填写模组包 ID。 修复了炮弹页面文字乱码的问题。 修复了生成的 UI Lua 绑定代码中的错误。 2023.4.5 同步更新了 API。 2023.3.27 修复了部分 Lua 面板未显示同步 Property 按钮的问题。 瞄具图片与文本现在支持挂载 Lua 脚本。 2023.3.26 编辑器内试车场增加了一键更新数据按钮。 窗口增加了是否优先读取编辑器本地资源的选项。 增加了 Lua Behavior 配置。 数据和 Text Data 数据现在都支持从编辑器直接读取，新数据无需重新打包即可生效。 类支持从 Lua 监听事件。 self.OnTotalDamageChanged = function(oldVal, newVal) print(tostring(oldVal) .. manual/mod/modding-issue-archive.html.title: 模组开发问题归档 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/modding-issue-archive.html.summary: 模组开发问题归档 中文 | English 这里记录旧版工具中遇到的问题和当时的排查方法。截图中的参数和入口来自当时的版本。 1. 地图空气碰撞 现象：地图某处存在看不见的碰撞，物体或弹道在该区域被挡住。 当时的排查：选中所有物体，检查是否有绿色碰撞框覆盖该区域；检查复制时是否多复制了一个 Mesh Collider，或把 Mesh Collider 放在了与显示模型不同的位置。 2. 悬挂回弹慢、转弯翻车 现象：车辆悬挂回弹缓慢，转弯时容易翻车。 当时的排查：检查 Wheel Collider 配置。下图为旧文档中称为“默认悬挂配置”的截图，仅作历史示例。 3. 地图炮弹碰撞与显示层级 旧文档用下图记录当时的地图炮弹碰撞与显示层级设置。 4. Blender 材质球重复问题 现象：用 Blender 复制物体后出现重复材质球。 旧文档记录了当时键位设置下两种复制方式得到的材质结果。使用当前 Blender 时，以你所用的键位和实际结果为准。 历史截图：使用 ctrl c 与 ctrl v 后的重复材质球。 历史截图：使用 shift + d 复制物体的结果。

manual/mod/multi-turret-legacy.html.title: 02.3 Multi-Fire (Old) - 多炮塔 （旧） | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/multi-turret-legacy.html.summary: 02.3 Multi-Fire (Old) - 多炮塔 （旧） 2.13 Blender 修正模型轴向 General 综合 Multi-Fire (Old) system is designed for one turret and one gun. 多炮塔（旧）系统被设计用于对应一个炮塔（Turret）与一门主炮（Gun）。 Child-Parent Relation 父子关系 Suppose we have an ATGM on the turret. We should SubTurret under Turret. Also you need to put SubGun under SubTurret and SubDym under SubTurret. 假设我们在炮塔上装备了 ATGM，则需要将 SubTurret 置于 Turret 之下。此外，需要将 SubGun 和 SubDym 均置于 SubTurret 之下。 Property 属性 Relative Path 相对路径 You need to set the relative path of turret ,gun and dym. 你需要分别设置炮塔（Turret）、主炮（Gun）和炮管（Dym）的相对路径。 FFPoint / Effect Start Offset 开火位置偏移 The offset will decide where ffpoint and effect start are. In the generated prefab, you can see the dummy points indicating these positions. 偏移量将决定开火点（ffpoint）和特效起始点（effect start）的位置。在生成的预制体中，可以看到指示这些位置的虚节点。 Tank Fire Param 开火设置 The structure is same as the ordinary one. 结构与普通的开火设置相同。 Turret Param 炮塔设置 The structure is same as the ordinary one. 结构与普通的炮塔设置相同。

manual/mod/official-art-assets.html.title: 28. Official Art Assets 官方美术资产库 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/official-art-assets.html.summary: 28. Official Art Assets 官方美术资产库 Repository 项目地址 Access to the repositories requires permission. Send your email address to the developers to apply. 仓库访问需要申请权限，请将邮箱地址发送给开发者。 Community Repository 通用仓库： https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/panzer-war-community-mods Sound Repository 音效仓库： https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/Panzer-War-Fmod Map Repository 地图仓库**（需与 Community Repository 父目录一致）** Must be cloned under the same parent directory as the Community Repository. 地图：https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/ShanghaiWindyMaps 公用资源：https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/ShanghaiWindyPublicResources Contribution 贡献方式 Use git to pull the project and create your own branch. Then push your branch. The developer will merge your branch to master branch. 使用 git 拉取项目，创建你的分支，然后推送该分支。开发者会将你的分支合并至 master 分支。 Tutorial 使用项目教程 Video 视频教程 装甲纷争 模组工程项目下载 使用 与提交修改教程_单机游戏热门视频 装甲纷争 模组工程 编写自定义脚本 以及调整载具数值_哔哩哔哩_bilibili Text 文本教程 1. Install Git 安装 Git 安装 Git 2. Install TortoiseGit 安装小乌龟 Git 2. 安装小乌龟 3. Pull Project 拉取项目 Click Git clone after installing TortoiseGit. 安装完 TortoiseGit 后，在右键菜单中点击 Git Clone... Open our repository and click clone. Copy the https link. 打开我们的项目地址，点击克隆，复制 https 链接。 Paste it into url 将其粘贴到 URL 输入框中。 Fill in the account in our gitlab. 输入我们在 GitLab 上的账号与密码。 4. Open the Project 打开项目 The main file is located at Assets/Res/Vehicles/Ground/Data 主要项目文件位于： Assets/Res/Vehicles/Ground/Data 路径下。 5. Commit Changes 提交修改 Follow the illustrated steps below to create a branch and commit your changes. 按照下方图文步骤创建分支并提交修改。 After creating the changes to the project, you need to create your own branch and commit changes. 当完成对工程的修改后，需要创建一个属于你的分支，然后再提交你的修改。 Create the branch. (Right click in the project folder!) 创建分支（请确保在项目文件夹内点击右键）。 Fill in the branch name. The branch name should be XXX-mod, where XXX describes what you changed. For example, the tank you modified and the content you modified on it. 输入分支名称。分支名称应为 XXX-mod，其中 XXX 应描述你的修改内容。例如：为 xxx 坦克修改了 xxx 内容。 Switch to your branch 然后切换到你的分支。 Toggle on your changes and commit. If some changes are not modified by yourself. Then do not toggle 勾选你自己的修改项，然后点击 Commit。如果看到有文件不是自己修改的，请勿勾选。 Click Push 点击 Push。 Confirm the branch name and click ok. 确认分支名称，然后点击 OK。 You can push many commits to your branch. As long as the modification is done. You can notify the developer to merge your changes to the game. 你可以在自己创建的分支进行多次修改提交。在确认自己的分支修改无误后，通知开发者合并你的分支。开发者会检查内容是否可以合入 master 主分支。在修改的内容被合入 master 主分支后，可执行下面一个步骤回到最新的项目。 6. Sync to the latest 同步项目到最新 After your changes are merged into master. You need to switch back to master and pull the latest project. The master branch contains your changes and others changes. 在你的分支被合入 master 主分支后，需要切回 master 分支，然后拉取最新工程。此时，工程会包含你的修改以及其他人的修改。 Switch back to master branch. 切回 master 分支。 Pull the latest files Pull 拉取最新的文件。 Now, the project is the latest. 此时，工程即为最新版本。若需要在最新的工程上进行修改，请重复步骤 5 的提交流程，创建新的分支提交即可。 If some error poped. Then click stash changes and then pull. 若拉取过程中出现报错，则点击 Stash Changes 按钮，然后再点击 Pull。 After pull then click stash pop 在 Pull 执行完毕后，点击 Stash Pop。 Git tools inside the editor 使用编辑器内 Git 工具 Using Git is the recommended way. 推荐使用 Git 方式。 Create a branch and commit changes 创建分支并提交修改 Pull the latest project 拉取最新项目 Switch back to the master branch, then click download and overwrite. 切换回 master 分支，然后点击下载并覆盖。 Notes 注意事项 Configuration file errors 配置文件报错 If a configuration file shows as Missing, report which file it is to the developers. 若存在配置文件显示为 Missing，请向开发者反馈具体是哪个文件。

maxSteerAngle 前轮 Wheels/FrontLeft、Wheels/FrontRight true true 28° 后轮 Wheels/RearLeft、Wheels/RearRight true false 0° 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": manual/mod/reactive-armor.html.summary: 配置反应装甲 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run reactive-armor --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "plate": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ReactivePlate.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 在载具伤害模型的 HitBox 上配置反应装甲。反应装甲会在有效命中点附近记录已消耗区域。 1. 选择 HitBox 打开载具的伤害模型 prefab，选中作为反应装甲的装甲部件。确认该物体有 HitBox 组件。教学配方新建一个独立的装甲样例。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${plate}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.HitBox" } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. 设置反应装甲参数 将「装甲类型」设为「反应 - Reactive」。展开「反应装甲」，将「反应装甲区块大小」设为 0.5，「反应装甲最大防御穿深厚度」设为 200。本例使用源码默认值。 区块大小是从已激活命中点量起的距离。后续命中落在该范围内时，该位置返回的装甲值为 0。未消耗位置使用配置的反应装甲值，是否击穿还取决于游戏的穿深计算。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${plate}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.HitBox", "values": { "hitBoxType": 3, "reactiveArmorSize": 0.5, "reactiveMaxProtectPenetration": 200 } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. 保存并核对 保存 prefab，重新核对装甲类型和两个数值。配方验证了编辑器保存回读。区块消耗、重复命中及修复应在游戏中检查。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${plate}/HitBox/hitBoxType" }, "expect": { "contains": "ReactiveArmor" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${plate}/HitBox/reactiveArmorSize" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single) 0.5" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${plate}/HitBox/reactiveMaxProtectPenetration" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single) 200" } } ]

manual/mod/shader-variant-collection.htm.title: 37. 着色器收集与打包 Shader Variant Collection and Build | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/shader-variant-collection.htm.summary: 37. 着色器收集与打包 Shader Variant Collection and Build 如果使用任何自定义着色器，请按以下方式收集其变体： If you use any custom shader, collect its variants as follows. 开启开发模式 Enable developer mode. 创建变体收集 Create a shader variant collection. 在模组打包文件上，选择刚刚创建的变体收集。 On the Mod build asset, select the variant collection you just created. 如果着色器存在自定义的着色器特性，则需将其填写在变体收集的列表中。 If the shader has custom shader features, you need to fill them into the list of the variant collection. 点击导出 Shader 变体 Click export shader variants. 会在模组打包文件下方，生成一份 svc 文件 An svc file will be generated under the Mod build asset. 拖入打包的资源列表，并勾选上共享相同的着色器。 Drag it into the asset list of the build, and tick share identical shaders. 打包后，我们会将所有的 Shader 放在一个 .shader 文件下。以保证所有的材质之间的shader ，公用一份。 After the build, all shaders are placed in a single .shader file, so that every material shares one copy of the shader. Sight Mod 瞄具模组 (未汉化) 打开项目 Open the project 在项目窗口中右键单击，然后选择此选项。 Right click in the project window and click this. 你可以参考此设置。Range 是绘制刻线时的目标距离。Number 是放置在刻线旁的文本。Notch Size 是从左侧增加刻线长度的数值。 You can refer this setting. "${fixture}/Tutorial_SharedTurret.asset", "spg": "${fixture}/Tutorial_SPG.asset", "td": "${fixture}/Tutorial_TD.asset", "strv": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Hydraulic.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", Hydraulic - 液压 资产。分别命名为 Tutorial_TD、Tutorial_SPG 和 Tutorial_Hydraulic。每个炮塔参数有一个 actionData 槽位。TD 资产用于启用车体辅助转向，资产本身没有额外参数。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.SPGTurretAction)", "${spg}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { 450。该值用于更新上帝视角相机，并参与计算目标不可达时的备用弹道预览时长。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${spg}/maxDistance", "value": "450" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 3. 设置 Strv 液压参数 选中 Tutorial_Hydraulic。本例保留三个攻击模式速度修正的默认值，填写以下悬挂与自动控制参数。 字段 值 attackingSuspension 0.5 wheelElevateClamp 0.45 maxElevateAnglePerSecond 0.1 autoPidFactors (3, 0, 2.5) Unity 校验资产时会取前三个值的绝对值，并将 wheelElevateClamp 限制在 attackingSuspension 以内。液压动作需要有 TrackController 和有效负重轮的履带底盘。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${strv}/attackingSuspension", "value": "0.5" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${strv}/wheelElevateClamp", "value": "0.45" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${strv}/maxElevateAnglePerSecond", "value": "0.1" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": Tutorial_SPG。如果要复用炮塔配置，打开一份 SharedTurretData 副本，将 turretParameter.actionData 设为 Tutorial_Hydraulic，然后将共享资产赋给载具的 sharedTurretData。 主炮塔优先使用共享资产的参数。挂上共享资产后，Inspector 会隐藏本地 MTParameter。简易火控系统各自读取自己的炮塔参数。 }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/MTParameter/actionData", "value": "@asset:${td}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "path": "asset:${vehicle}/sharedTurretData", "value": "@asset:${shared}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 5. 保存并核对动作引用 保存资产后，确认本地 actionData 仍是 Tutorial_SPG。挂上共享资产后，生效的动作应为 Tutorial_Hydraulic，其 manual/mod/tank-shell-ejection-animation.summary: 制作坦克抛壳动画 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run tank-shell-ejection-animation --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "rig": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellRig.fbx", "model": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellRig.prefab", "clip": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellEject.anim", "script": "${fixture}/PlayAnimationComponent.lua" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 本教程改编自樱花的《坦克抛壳动画》。示例先在 Blender 准备炮塔下的弹壳和抛壳装置，再在 Unity 制作动画，最后用 Lua 将剪辑接到开火事件。 1. 准备并导入模型 在 Blender 中将弹壳放到炮塔内，设为炮塔的子级。本例将弹壳节点命名为 Casing。把抛壳装置的枢轴设在旋转中心。如果旋转轴和全局坐标轴不重合，可以放置并旋转一个空物体作为父级。本例用 MechanismPivot 表示这个空物体。 导出 FBX 后导入 Unity，确认模型下保留 Turret/Casing 和 Turret/MechanismPivot，再创建用于配置的 prefab。配方用 Blender 后台模式生成并导出教学样例。如果 Unity 找不到 Blender，启动编辑器前设置 BLENDER 指向可执行文件。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/ExportRig", "args": [ "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellRig.fbx" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/EnsureRigPrefab", "args": [ "${rig}", "${model}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Turret/Casing/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String) Casing" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Turret/MechanismPivot/Mechanism/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String) Mechanism" } } ] 2. 制作并分配动画 在 Unity 的 Animation 窗口中选择 prefab 根节点，创建 Tutorial_ShellEject.anim 剪辑。为 Casing 的局部 Position 添加起点、抛出和复位三个关键帧。本例在 0.2 秒沿局部 X 轴移动 0.35 个单位，在 0.4 秒回到起点。装置通过 MechanismPivot 的局部 Rotation 曲线在 0.2 秒转到 35° 的打开姿态，随后复位。 将剪辑设为 Legacy，Wrap Mode 保持 Default。在根节点添加 Animation，指定默认剪辑并关闭 Play Automatically，让 Lua 控制播放。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/WriteClip", "args": [ "${fixture}", "${model}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Turret/Casing/m_LocalPosition.x: 3 keys" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/AssignClip", "args": [ "${model}", "${clip}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellEject" } } ] 3. 绑定开火事件 在同一个根节点添加 LuaBehaviorMono，将以下脚本保存为 PlayAnimationComponent.lua 并赋给「行为脚本」。脚本在载具加载后监听第一个火力系统的开火事件。多炮载具应按实际火力列表选择索引。 Behavior() Property = {} local PlayAnimationComponent = class("PlayAnimationComponent") function PlayAnimationComponent:OnStarted() local animation = self.script:GetNativeComponent("Animation") local found, vehicle = self.script:TryGetTankInitSystem() if not animation or not found then return end VehicleAPI.RegisterVehicleLoadedEvent(vehicle, function() VehicleAPI.RegisterBulletFiredEvent(vehicle, 0, function() animation:Play() end) end) end return PlayAnimationComponent 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/ImportBehavior", "args": [ "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "PlayAnimationComponent.lua" } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.Lua.LuaBehaviorMono", "references": [ { "property": "luaBehavior", "asset": "${script}", "type": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.Lua.LuaBehaviorScript" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. 保存并核对 保存 prefab，检查 Animation 和 LuaBehaviorMono 在同一个节点上，再核对默认剪辑、Legacy 设置和 Lua 引用。配方回读了位置曲线和旋转曲线。还需在完整载具上试射，确认开火回调和动画在游戏中按预期运行。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${clip}/legacy" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${clip}/wrapMode" }, "expect": { "contains": "Default" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Animation/clip/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellEject" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Animation/playAutomatically" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) False" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/LuaBehaviorMono/luaBehavior/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "PlayAnimationComponent" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/LuaBehaviorMono/luaBehavior/lua" }, "expect": { "contains": "RegisterBulletFiredEvent" } } ]

manual/mod/texture-channel-conversion-to.title: 17.1 常用的贴图通道转换工具 Common Texture Channel Conversion Tools | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/texture-channel-conversion-to.summary: 17.1 常用的贴图通道转换工具 Common Texture Channel Conversion Tools 使用 Substance 3D Designer 合并 ORM 通道 Merging ORM Channels with Substance 3D Designer 请从 Adobe Substance 3D Designer 官方页面 安装已授权的当前版本。旧文档中关于“替换 Substance Designer.exe”的做法来源不可信，现已删除，请勿使用修改过的可执行文件。 Install a licensed current version from the official Adobe Substance 3D Designer page. The old documentation described replacing Substance Designer.exe; that came from an untrustworthy source and has been removed. Do not use a modified executable. ORM 贴图的通道约定为：R = Ambient Occlusion、G = Roughness、B = Metallic。使用 RGBA Merge 节点，将三张灰度贴图分别连接到 R、G、B 输入，并将结果按线性颜色空间导出。 The channel convention for an ORM texture is R = Ambient Occlusion, G = Roughness, B = Metallic. Use the RGBA Merge node to connect the three grayscale textures to the R, G and B inputs respectively, then export the result in linear color space. 若要调整已有 ORM 贴图的通道，请先用 RGBA Split 拆分，再通过 RGBA Merge 按上述顺序重新连接。以下截图仅作为节点连接方式参考。 To rearrange the channels of an existing ORM texture, split it with RGBA Split first, then reconnect the channels in the order above with RGBA Merge. The screenshots below are only a reference for how the nodes are connected.

manual/mod/upload-naming-art-standards.h.title: 28.1. Upload, Naming and Art Standards 上传、命名与美术规范 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/upload-naming-art-standards.h.summary: 28.1. Upload, Naming and Art Standards 上传、命名与美术规范 1. Upload Standards 上传规范 每个分支应尽可能减少修改内容。理想情况下，一个分支仅包含一辆坦克或一架飞机的修改。切记，不要在一个分支内提交大量载具修改后再进行合并，此类合并将无法通过。 Each branch should contain as few changes as possible — ideally one branch per tank or aircraft. Never commit a large batch of vehicle changes on a single branch and then ask for a merge; such merges will not be accepted. 2. Naming Standards 命名规范 任何文件名应以大写字母开头，随后接小写字母，例如： Every file name should begin with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters, for example: 任何文件都应具有清晰明确的名称，而非一串乱码。 Every file should have a clear, meaningful name instead of a string of gibberish. 尽量避免拼写错误。 Try not to misspell words. 3. When Modifying an Existing Model, Replace the Fbx Instead of Adding a New One 在原本模型上进行修改，应替换 Fbx 而非新增 Fbx 导出新的 fbx 并覆盖原本的 fbx 文件。此步骤可在建模软件导出时执行，或在文件夹中通过复制文件进行覆盖。无法在 Unity 编辑器内直接完成。如果在 fbx 内新增了模型，请将新的 fbx 拖入空场景，然后将新增部分复制到原本的旧预制体内。 Export the new fbx and overwrite the original fbx file. You can overwrite it while exporting from your modelling software, or by copying the file over in the folder. This cannot be done directly inside the Unity editor. If you added new models inside the fbx, drag the new fbx into an empty scene, then copy the newly added parts into the original old prefab. 切记，不要因为对 fbx 新增一块区域的模型，就只是新增一个 fbx 文件。这会导致出现 XXX_fix.fbx、XXX_fix2.fbx 等文件，造成项目文件混乱。 Never add a separate fbx file just because you added one more piece of geometry. It leads to XXX_fix.fbx, XXX_fix2.fbx and so on, which turns the project files into a mess. 4. Do Not Reuse One Texture for Both Normal and RGB Maps, and Do Not Set Normal Strength 法线图与 RGB 图不要用一张，不要设置 Normal 强度 解决方法： Solution: 在建模软件中，不要将 RGB 图引用给 Normal，也不要设置 Normal 强度。 In your modelling software, do not feed the RGB map into Normal, and do not set the Normal strength. 例如，在 Blender 中删除以下节点： For example, in Blender, delete the following node: 以及删除以下节点： And delete the following node as well: 5. Avoid Duplicate Materials 避免重复的材质球 重复的材质球指的是使用相同贴图但应用了不同材质球的情况。这会增加渲染压力。 Duplicate materials means separate materials that use exactly the same textures. This increases the rendering cost. 重复的材质球通常出现在 Blender 中使用 Ctrl+C 和 Ctrl+V 复制物体时。我们建议使用 Shift+D 的方式复制物体，以避免创建重复的材质球。 Duplicate materials usually appear after copying objects in Blender with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V. We recommend duplicating objects with Shift+D instead, so that no duplicate material is created. 对于已经创建的重复材质球，需要在 Blender 中手动将引用的材质球统一替换为相同的材质，以避免重复。 For duplicates that already exist, you have to switch the referenced materials manually in Blender so that they all point to the same material. 下拉框可以显示目前还有哪些材质存在重复，通常重复的材质名称会以 .001、.002 结尾。 The dropdown shows which materials are still duplicated; duplicated ones normally end with .001, .002 and so on. 可以使用上方的搜索框搜索重复的材质名称。 You can use the search box above to look up duplicated material names.

manual/mod/upload-to-modhub.html.title: 36. Upload to Official ModHub 上传模组到官方平台 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/upload-to-modhub.html.summary: 36. Upload to Official ModHub 上传模组到官方平台 We understand that creating Mods is not easy, but due to reasons such as model accuracy and data parameters, you may encounter dissatisfaction from some players. Please ensure you are mentally prepared before proceeding with the upload. 我们明白制作模组不易，但由于模型考据、数据参数等原因，你可能会遭到部分玩家的不满。请确保你已经做好充分的心理准备再进行上传。 Upload Qualifications 上传资格 All Mod authors can upload their Mods without undergoing a review process. However, only Mods that are original are eligible for upload. Please ensure that the Mods you upload comply with the CC BY-NC license. By uploading a Mod, you agree to the principles of free and open sharing, making the Mod freely available for distribution by any player without restrictions. Note: Mods with copyright disputes will not qualify for incentives. 所有模组作者可以无需审核直接上传模组。但请确保上传的模组为原创。上传的模组必须遵守 CC BY-NC 协议。上传即代表自愿公开流通模组，同意模组以自由的方式传播，不限制任何玩家进行传播。注意：上传的模组若存在版权争议将无法获得激励金。 Tool Usages 工具用法 Open the tool - 打开工具 Enter Your Account - 输入你的账号密码 Configure your account and click save at the bottom 配置你的账号，然后点击底部的保存选项 Pick the account by clicking this button 点击此按钮选择你的账号 Pick File 选择文件 Pick a mod package file to upload, or pick a folder by the second button 选择模组文件进行上传，或者通过第二个按钮，批量上传文件夹中的 mod package 文件 If you need to upgrade the Mod, then need to change the version. +1 version to make it upgradable. 若模组需要进行更新，则需要进行版本变更，需要 +1 的版本号，才可正常进行更新。 Contract with us 与我们签订创作激励收益 Once your original, high-quality, and free Mod achieves a certain number of downloads on the Mod downloader, we will offer you an incentive agreement. This agreement will provide a reward ranging from 50 to 500 SGD, depending on the quality of your Mod. Please note that a Singapore bank account is required to receive the reward. 一旦你的原创、高质量、免费的模组在模组下载器上达到一定的下载量，我们将与你签订激励协议。根据模组的质量，我们会提供 50 至 500 新币不等的奖励。请注意，需要提供一张新加坡银行卡来接收奖励。 Prohibition of Illegal Use of Mods 禁止非法利用模组 It is strictly forbidden for any user to utilize uploaded public Mods and their related files for illegal fundraising, fraud, or commercial activities in any form. If such behavior is discovered, we will pursue legal action in accordance with the law. 严禁任何使用者以任何形式利用已上传的公开模组及其相关文件进行非法集资、诈骗或商业活动。如发现此类行为，我们将依法追究相关法律责任。

You need to accept the Steam Workshop legal agreement for this game before you can upload items!
